job.title: Principal Engineer, System HW Design - SI/PI
job.description:
Principal Engineer, System HW Design – Signal Integrity / Power Integrity (SI/PI)

Overview

Lead the signal integrity and power integrity strategy for a portfolio of advanced machine-learning hardware platforms. As Principal Engineer, System HW Design – SI/PI, you will help design, build, bring up, characterize, and productize PCB systems spanning System-on-Module designs, PCIe add-in cards, chip-down BGA reference designs, development kits, and future platforms.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role for an engineer who can establish organization-wide SI/PI standards, guide complex board designs, close high-speed interface margins, and solve the most challenging lab validation and bring-up issues. You will work across ASIC, package, hardware, layout, firmware, manufacturing, and external vendor teams to deliver reliable high-speed signaling and power delivery for advanced compute systems.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Approximately 15 years of industry experience in signal integrity and power integrity engineering for high-speed digital systems.
  • Experience leading SI/PI strategy across multiple concurrent hardware programs.
  • Deep expertise with:
  • PCIe Gen4/Gen5, including PCIe Gen5 operation up to 32 GT/s per lane.
  • DDR4, DDR5, and LPDDR memory channels.
  • USB 3.x and USB Type-C.
  • MIPI D-PHY and C-PHY.
  • 10 Gigabit Ethernet SerDes.
  • Proven experience driving high-speed interface margin closure on production designs.
  • Track record owning power delivery network architecture for high-power SoCs, ASICs, AI accelerators, GPUs, or comparable compute silicon.
  • Expert proficiency with SI/PI EDA tools such as Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Cadence Sigrity/Clarity, Keysight ADS, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience selecting SI/PI tools and developing reusable simulation methodologies.
  • Extensive hands-on lab validation experience using VNAs, TDRs, and high-bandwidth oscilloscopes.
  • Experience owning escalation-level SI/PI debug.
  • Expertise in PCB stack-up design, impedance control, transmission line theory, S-parameters, and channel modeling.
  • Strong working knowledge of PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, and MIPI Alliance compliance standards.
  • Ability to define technical direction, establish engineering standards, and mentor senior- and staff-level engineers.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align ASIC, package, hardware, layout, and firmware teams.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Knowledge of ASIC characterization, PCB manufacturing, assembly, test, quality, and reliability.
  • Experience supporting or owning PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, or MIPI Alliance compliance testing.
  • Experience defining connector and interconnect strategies across multiple product generations.
  • Experience working with board-to-board, M.2 NVMe, and PCIe edge-card interfaces.
  • Experience engaging with component and module vendors or industry standards organizations.
  • A record of delivering complex technical programs in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Creative and intellectually curious approach to solving challenging hardware problems.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline required.
  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Approximately 15 years of professional experience in SI/PI engineering for high-speed digital systems preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience providing product-line-level technical leadership across multiple board programs.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in San Jose.
  • Contract assignment initially expected to run for six months, with potential for extension.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across internal engineering teams and external vendors.
  • Ability to drive long-term SI/PI architecture, methodology, and standards while remaining hands-on with design, simulation, validation, and debug.

job.title: Sr. Financial Analyst or Finance Manager
job.description:
Senior Financial Analyst / Finance Manager – Marketing & GTM Finance

Overview

A publicly traded, high-tech SaaS organization is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst or Finance Manager to support its Marketing and Go-to-Market finance function on a contract basis. This high-impact role will partner directly with senior Marketing leadership and collaborate with multiple Vice Presidents to evaluate spending priorities, strengthen financial reporting, and provide strategic analysis that supports business decisions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on finance professional who can manage budgeting and forecasting, assess return on investment, reconcile financial data, and provide sound guidance in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This is a 100% remote opportunity with an anticipated start date of 12/01/2026 and an initial duration of 2–6 months, with potential for extension as the organization evaluates its long-term needs.

Required Skills

  • Experience with budgeting and forecasting for Marketing and/or Go-to-Market functions
  • Experience developing and reporting on an Annual Operating Plan (AOP)
  • Strong financial analysis, reporting, and data-reconciliation skills
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies between accruals and actuals
  • Experience evaluating Marketing spend, business initiatives, and event performance
  • Ability to analyze pipeline generated and assess the return on investment of strategic investments
  • Strong Excel skills and experience working with large datasets
  • Ability to manage ad hoc financial requests and collaborate effectively with cross-functional business partners
  • Strong judgment, ownership, and attention to detail
  • Ability to review purchase orders and accruals, support reconciliations, answer questions, and provide guidance to a junior Financial Analyst
  • Experience building sales quotas for territories
  • Ability to provide direction, mentorship, and hands-on support to junior team members

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Experience with Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, or a similar financial planning and analysis platform
  • Public company experience and familiarity with related financial processes and best practices
  • High-tech or SaaS industry experience
  • Experience partnering directly with a Chief Marketing Officer or other senior executive
  • Experience consolidating spending requests across multiple Marketing leaders and assessing financial feasibility against an overall budget
  • Experience with OfficeConnect or similar tools used to extract and analyze financial data in Excel

Preferred Education and Experience

The provided role details do not specify a required educational background. Candidates should bring relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, Marketing finance, Go-to-Market finance, or a closely related function, with a level of expertise aligned with either a Senior Financial Analyst or Finance Manager position.

Experience in public companies, high-tech or SaaS organizations, Marketing finance, and strategic financial analysis is preferred but not required.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote
  • Location requirement: Candidates must be located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones to align with the broader team
  • Engagement: Contract position
  • Anticipated start date: 12/01/2026
  • Initial duration: 2–6 months, with potential for extension
  • The role requires the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide practical financial guidance in a changing environment.

job.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
job.description:
Revenue Operations Analyst

Overview

Support the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of a high-impact go-to-market organization as a Revenue Operations Analyst. This role is responsible for structuring and validating sales opportunities, interpreting customer agreements, completing pricing calculations, and ensuring deals are booked in alignment with company policies and SaaS revenue guidelines.

Working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Billing, FP&A, and Sales Operations, you will help improve deal execution, revenue reporting, forecasting, operational processes, and data integrity. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on revenue operations while advising internal teams on deal structure, approvals, bookings, and process improvements.

Position Details:

  • Contract duration: Approximately 4 months
  • Anticipated start date: 11/23/2026
  • Location: San Francisco, CA, or remote; the role is intended to support a remote arrangement, with onsite expectations to be confirmed

Required Skills

  • Experience supporting revenue operations, deal desk, sales operations, business operations, or a related function
  • Strong ability to review, interpret, and understand complex customer agreements and legal contracts
  • Experience structuring and validating sales opportunities in Salesforce
  • Knowledge of booking policies, SaaS revenue guidelines, and revenue recognition considerations
  • Ability to extract contract data and accurately complete pricing calculations in relevant tools and systems of record
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate deal structures and provide clear recommendations
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Billing, FP&A, and Sales Operations
  • Ability to maintain accurate and reliable sales data in Salesforce and related revenue systems
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through when managing multiple deal reviews and approvals
  • Ability to manage operational inquiries and resolve requests within established service-level agreements
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain policies, procedures, and booking guidelines to internal stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting pricing strategy initiatives or gathering market and pricing intelligence
  • Experience developing pricing models for new business and customer expansion opportunities
  • Familiarity with deal desk operations, bookings analysis, forecasting impacts, and revenue recognition
  • Experience documenting and maintaining sales policies and operational processes across business units or geographic regions
  • Background supporting reporting, pipeline metrics, bookings analysis, sales enablement tools, or KPI standardization
  • Experience coordinating approvals with Legal, Security, Tax, Data Ethics, Insurance, or similar internal stakeholders
  • Experience providing training or guidance on Salesforce opportunity structure and best practices
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and implement operational best practices that improve efficiency

Preferred Education and Experience

Specific degree requirements and minimum years of experience were not provided. Candidates with relevant experience in revenue operations, deal desk, sales operations, pricing operations, SaaS finance, or a closely related discipline are preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate across multiple functions and teams
  • Availability to support time-sensitive deal reviews, including end-of-quarter activities
  • Ability to manage competing priorities while meeting established service-level agreements
  • Strong commitment to data accuracy, process consistency, and confidentiality when handling customer agreements and business information
  • The position is listed as San Francisco, CA / remote; the final onsite or remote schedule will be confirmed for the selected candidate

job.title: Full Stack Web Developer

Join a fully remote contract engagement as a Full Stack Web Developer, contributing across the web application development lifecycle. This opportunity is ideal for a developer who can support both front-end and back-end development while collaborating effectively in a remote work environment. Two contract positions are available.

job.title: Stock Administration Consultant (Part Time, Remote)
job.description:
Stock Administration Consultant (Part Time, Remote)

Overview

Support the accurate and efficient administration of an equity compensation program in this high-impact consulting role. The Stock Administration Consultant will serve as the primary day-to-day administrator of the company’s equity management platform, managing transactions, reporting, vesting activity, and related documentation for an employee and director population of 60+.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced stock administration professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, works independently, and can quickly take ownership of critical processes. The consultant will collaborate with Legal, Payroll, Accounting, and Finance to ensure equity activity is accurately recorded, aligned with board approvals, and supported by effective policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and process equity transactions in Certent by insightsoftware, including:
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Restricted Stock Awards (RSAs)
  • Performance Stock Units (PSUs)
  • Warrants
  • Forfeitures
  • Track PSU milestones and related award activity.
  • Process vested equity award releases, including sell-to-cover calculations and payroll coordination.
  • Prepare monthly rollforward reports reflecting equity and share balances, grants, vesting activity, and forfeitures.
  • Reconcile cap table activity and maintain accurate equity records.
  • Ensure equity-related transactions are properly documented and aligned with board approvals.
  • Coordinate data flow and process accuracy across Legal, Payroll, Accounting, and Finance.
  • Develop and improve policies, procedures, and operating processes related to stock administration and key SOX process areas.
  • Support accurate reporting, compliance, and ongoing administration of the equity compensation program.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience administering equity or stock compensation programs.
  • Experience with Certent by insightsoftware is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of RSUs, RSAs, PSUs, warrants, vesting, and forfeitures.
  • Experience reconciling cap tables and preparing grant, vesting, forfeiture, and equity rollforward reports.
  • Familiarity with board approval documentation and equity transaction controls.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proactive communication and strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver results with minimal direction.
  • Capacity to quickly assume ownership in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Background in accounting or familiarity with stock-based compensation accounting.
  • Experience supporting audits or financial reporting processes.
  • Exposure to ERP systems, particularly NetSuite.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, or SOX-related process documentation.
  • Experience supporting equity administration within a public company or a company that has recently completed a public-market transaction.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Relevant education and professional experience in stock administration, equity compensation, accounting, finance, or a related discipline are preferred.
  • Prior hands-on experience managing equity programs and administering transactions through Certent is highly valued.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote.
  • Schedule: Approximately 6–12 hours per week, with flexible scheduling and consistent availability during the business week.
  • Engagement: Indefinite consulting engagement.
  • Start: As soon as possible.
  • Must be able to independently support ongoing equity administration while maintaining responsiveness and accuracy across a distributed team.

job.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - Supply Chain
job.description:
Senior Technical Project Manager – Supply Chain / Source-to-Pay

Overview

Lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that improve the systems and processes supporting Supply Chain and Source-to-Pay operations. This senior-level role will help optimize a procurement technology ecosystem, address platform functionality and user experience challenges, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management expertise with business and product-oriented thinking. You will work across engineering, procurement, supply chain, finance, and other business teams to bring structure to complex initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive programs from planning through execution. Success in this role requires a hands-on, highly organized leader who can influence without direct authority and operate effectively in a fast-changing environment.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Approximately 10 years of experience in technical program management, technology project management, or complex enterprise technology delivery.
  • Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional technology programs involving both engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira Cloud, including:
  • Setting up and organizing projects and programs.
  • Breaking initiatives into milestones, deliverables, and actionable workstreams.
  • Tracking dependencies, risks, issues, and progress.
  • Maintaining accurate, organized, and actionable project documentation.
  • Experience managing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID).
  • Strong understanding of the distinction between project and program management, including how initiatives align with broader portfolio objectives.
  • Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into actionable technical deliverables.
  • Ability to create, refine, and maintain business requirements documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate challenging stakeholder relationships.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflicts, and de-escalate difficult situations.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive initiatives forward with limited direction.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment with shifting priorities.
  • Ability to understand technical discussions, system integrations, dependencies, and business requirements.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Coupa, particularly in procurement or Source-to-Pay environments.
  • Familiarity with NetSuite and enterprise system integrations.
  • Understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and related procurement, finance, and supply chain workflows.
  • Experience with enterprise platform implementations, post-implementation optimization, or technology transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working closely with engineering organizations to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
  • Exposure to product management methodologies and practices.
  • Experience optimizing platform functionality, workflows, processes, and user experiences.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and aligning technology initiatives with organizational objectives.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred educational background is not specified in the provided job details.
  • Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in technical program management, technology project management, enterprise technology delivery, or a closely related field.
  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms, integrations, or Supply Chain and Source-to-Pay technology initiatives is strongly preferred.
  • Direct Coupa experience is a significant advantage but is not required.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location: Sunnyvale, California, with the ability to work onsite approximately two to three days per week as needed.
  • Candidates should be based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Ability to collaborate with geographically distributed teams, including East Coast stakeholders, which may require occasional early-morning meetings.
  • Initial contract duration is six months, with the potential for extension.
  • This is a senior-level engagement requiring an experienced, independent contributor.

job.title: Senior Contracts Manager
job.description:
Senior Contracts Manager

Overview

Lead the full lifecycle of complex enterprise procurement contracts in a high-impact, fast-paced environment. The Senior Contracts Manager will drive strategic planning, drafting, negotiation, execution, and post-signature review for high-value vendor agreements while helping the business manage risk, improve efficiency, and achieve strategic goals.

This role partners closely with Legal, Privacy, Security, Finance, and business stakeholders to develop effective contract strategies, advise on risk-reward tradeoffs, resolve complex disputes, and ensure agreements align with organizational policies and risk tolerance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, confident collaborator, and highly adaptable contracts professional who can operate autonomously, manage competing priorities, and deliver with precision under pressure.

Required Skills

  • 6–8+ years of advanced experience managing complex commercial contracts in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, or a Commercial Legal environment
  • Demonstrated ability to independently draft, review, and negotiate complex, high-value commercial agreements
  • Experience managing the end-to-end contracting process, from intake and strategic planning through execution and post-signature review
  • Strong understanding of commercial contract law, data security, and privacy regulations, including GDPR and CCPA
  • Ability to identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate contractual, legal, and commercial risks
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to develop creative solutions and provide sound recommendations to cross-functional and business leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to build relationships, collaborate effectively, and influence stakeholders at multiple levels
  • Highly organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives independently
  • Experience using contract management tools and systems to improve workflow efficiency, data integrity, and lifecycle visibility
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-paced, high-expectation environment while maintaining professionalism and accuracy
  • Demonstrated commitment to corporate policies, ethical standards, and applicable regulatory requirements

Nice to Have Skills

  • Deep familiarity with SaaS, cybersecurity, infrastructure, OEM supplier, or marketing technology agreements
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Privacy, Security, Finance, and business teams on complex contracting matters
  • Experience resolving complex contract-related disputes while maintaining positive vendor relationships
  • Experience optimizing contracting workflows and driving process improvements
  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members
  • Strong KPI orientation and experience using data to evaluate contracting performance and efficiency

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Law, or a related field preferred
  • 6–8+ years of progressively advanced experience in commercial contracts, procurement, strategic sourcing, or a related function
  • Experience managing sophisticated enterprise vendor agreements in a technology-focused environment preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Preferred working hours: Central Standard Time (CST)
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Assignment duration: 1 year
  • Anticipated start date: November 30

job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:
Payroll Specialist

Overview

Join a fast-growing technology environment as a Payroll Specialist supporting accurate, compliant, and timely payroll operations for U.S. and international employees. In this hands-on role, you will partner with Payroll, People, Finance, and Legal teams to manage multiple employee populations, countries, systems, and pay cycles.

The ideal candidate is self-sufficient, adaptable, highly detail-oriented, and comfortable moving quickly in a startup-style environment. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to evolving payroll operations while supporting a growing global workforce.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of payroll processing experience, including multi-state and global payroll
  • Hands-on experience with ADP, including reporting, compliance tools, and international payroll workflows
  • Experience processing payroll for hourly and salaried employees across varying pay cycles
  • Experience supporting payroll across 20+ U.S. states
  • Strong understanding of wage and hour laws, tax withholdings, payroll taxes, and regulatory compliance
  • Experience managing or supporting weekly, biweekly, and monthly payroll cycles
  • Experience transitioning payroll providers or migrating payroll platforms end to end, including:
  • Data migration
  • Parallel payroll runs
  • Reconciliation
  • Post-implementation support
  • Ability to support payroll operations for international employees
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain confidential employee information
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and collaborating with cross-functional teams
  • Strong technical aptitude and proficiency with payroll systems and tools

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Rippling
  • Payroll experience in international markets such as the United Kingdom, Canada, Singapore, Japan, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Australia, or Korea
  • Experience supporting payroll within a high-growth startup or rapidly scaling organization
  • Knowledge of accounting or finance principles
  • Experience coordinating time tracking and wage data for hourly employees
  • Experience partnering with People or HR teams to onboard employees into payroll systems
  • Workday experience

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive payroll experience preferred
  • Experience managing multi-state and international payroll required
  • Educational requirements were not specified

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with two days onsite in San Francisco each week
  • Schedule: Part-time, generally 20–30 hours per week, with the opportunity for hours to increase as the organization grows; some weeks may require a full-time schedule
  • Must be comfortable working in a dynamic, startup-style environment
  • Must be able to support payroll operations for approximately 25 hourly employees and 500 domestic and 100 international salaried employees
  • Must support payroll for employees across the United States and international locations
  • Must stay current on payroll best practices, legislative changes, and compliance requirements
  • Standard background check required

job.title: International Payroll Specialist - APAC
job.description:
International Payroll Specialist – APAC

Overview

Own and elevate payroll operations across the Asia-Pacific region in this high-impact, hands-on opportunity with a fast-growing technology organization. As the International Payroll Specialist – APAC, you will manage monthly payroll for Australia and Singapore, lead the launch of South Korea payroll, oversee Japan payroll activities, and partner with global teams and external providers to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely employee payments.

This role is ideal for an experienced international payroll professional who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys building processes from the ground up, and can balance day-to-day payroll execution with international implementations and continuous improvement. You will develop country-specific runbooks, maintain the APAC compliance calendar, reconcile payroll registers to Workday, support provider relationships, and help ensure a consistent employee experience across multiple countries.

Required Skills

  • Five or more years of payroll experience, including hands-on responsibility for at least two of the following countries:
  • Australia
  • Singapore
  • South Korea
  • Japan
  • Working knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including:
  • PAYG withholding
  • Superannuation guarantee
  • Single Touch Payroll (STP)
  • State payroll tax
  • Working knowledge of Singapore payroll requirements, including:
  • Central Provident Fund (CPF)
  • Skills Development Levy (SDL)
  • IR8A
  • Equivalent depth of experience in South Korean or Japanese payroll, with the ability and willingness to learn additional APAC payroll requirements
  • Experience running payroll through an outsourced provider and reviewing provider output
  • Ability to reconcile payroll registers to an HRIS, preferably Workday; investigate variances; and confirm funding
  • Experience processing new hires, terminations, final pay, one-time payments, commissions, and reimbursements
  • Strong process documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with US-based teams and vendors across multiple time zones
  • Strong judgment when handling confidential payroll and employee data
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience launching payroll in a new country
  • Japanese or Korean language skills
  • Experience with weConnect, Breeze, SmartHR, or ADP Celergo
  • Experience with Workday Payroll or Workday HCM integrations with local payroll providers
  • Experience working for a high-growth technology company expanding into new countries
  • Experience managing or mentoring a part-time or junior payroll resource
  • Experience with payroll implementation planning, provider management, and internal audit processes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, human resources, business administration, or a related field preferred
  • Five or more years of progressive international payroll experience
  • Direct responsibility for payroll operations in at least two APAC countries
  • Experience supporting payroll compliance, provider relationships, process development, and payroll implementations strongly preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Remote
  • Engagement: Six-month contract-to-hire opportunity
  • Ability to support recurring payroll deadlines and collaborate with teams and vendors across APAC and US time zones
  • Ability to complete a background check
  • Willingness to operate effectively in a dynamic, rapidly changing startup environment
  • Ability to develop and maintain country-specific payroll runbooks and an APAC compliance calendar
  • Ability to support payroll provider coordination, employee inquiries, monthly audits, funding requests, and implementation milestones

job.title: International Payroll Specialist - EMEA
job.description:
International Payroll Specialist – EMEA

Overview

Own the monthly payroll cycle for four European entities across the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Spain in a fast-paced technology environment. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced payroll professional who can manage complex, multi-country payroll operations while strengthening controls and transforming a manual, person-dependent process into a clear, scalable operation.

Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you will oversee payroll inputs through funding and reconciliation, partner closely with outsourced payroll providers, support employees across the region, and create documented country-specific procedures that improve accuracy, consistency, and service. You will also contribute to planned Netherlands and Sweden payroll implementations in 2027.

Required Skills

  • Five or more years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Practical payroll experience in at least one of the following countries: Germany, France, or Spain.
  • Working knowledge of:
  • UK PAYE and National Insurance.
  • Auto-enrollment pensions and statutory payments.
  • RTI, FPS, P45s, P60s, and P11Ds.
  • Statutory deductions and filings applicable to other supported countries.
  • Experience managing payroll through an outsourced provider, including reviewing provider output rather than only entering data.
  • Ability to prepare and review monthly payroll inputs, including:
  • New starters and right-to-work information.
  • Leavers and P45s.
  • Salary and job changes.
  • One-time payments, commissions, expenses, and benefit deductions.
  • Experience reviewing gross-to-net, variance, and payroll register reports.
  • Strong reconciliation skills, including reconciling payroll registers to an HRIS and prior-month results.
  • Ability to investigate, document, and clearly explain payroll variances.
  • Experience preparing payroll funding requests and supporting documentation.
  • Familiarity with UK benefits administration, including Smart Pension, salary sacrifice, private medical benefits, and dependent health elections.
  • Ability to manage country-specific payroll requirements, including French statutory leave, German benefit uploads, and year-end filings.
  • Strong employee service skills and the ability to respond to payroll questions clearly and accurately.
  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication with employees, Finance teams, payroll vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently across GMT and CET hours while collaborating with a US-based team.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential payroll and employee information.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • CIPP certification or an equivalent payroll qualification.
  • Experience with ADP Celergo or ADP local payroll platforms, including:
  • ADP UK iHCM 2.
  • ADP Germany Easypay.
  • Pegases for France.
  • SINCRO for Spain.
  • Experience with Workday or another HR information system.
  • Experience documenting payroll standard operating procedures or leading payroll process improvements.
  • German, French, or Spanish language skills.
  • Experience with Remote or another global payroll platform.
  • Experience supporting multi-country payroll implementations, including data mapping, parallel runs, and first payrolls.
  • Experience in a fast-growing technology company with frequent new hires, equity events, and commission payments.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace and Slack.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Five or more years of professional payroll experience, including substantial UK payroll ownership and experience supporting at least one additional European country.
  • A payroll certification such as CIPP or an equivalent credential is preferred.
  • No specific college degree requirement was provided; relevant payroll expertise, country-specific compliance knowledge, and experience managing outsourced payroll operations are highly valued.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Contract term: Six months, with the possibility of extension.
  • Availability to support payroll activities across GMT and CET working hours while partnering with a US-based team.
  • Ability to meet recurring country-specific payroll cutoffs, approval timelines, funding deadlines, and payment dates.
  • Successful completion of a background check.
  • Ability to support Netherlands and Sweden payroll implementations planned for 2027.
  • Commitment to maintaining strict confidentiality of employee, payroll, tax, and financial information.

job.title: Talent Transformation Program Manager - Strategic Accounts
job.description:
Talent Transformation Program Manager – Strategic Accounts

Overview

Lead high-impact talent transformation programs for strategic enterprise customers investing in data, analytics, AI, and cloud enablement. As the single point of accountability for each customer’s training program, you’ll turn learning investments into measurable business outcomes by driving engagement, developing structured learning plans, coordinating delivery across multiple teams, and identifying opportunities for expansion and renewal.

This role combines program management, customer success, account management, and technical discovery. You’ll partner with account executives, solutions architects, professional services, instructors, curriculum teams, certification teams, and training operations to help customers build the skills needed to advance their strategic initiatives.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, customer success, account management, training, or a related discipline
  • At least 1 year of experience in data, analytics, artificial intelligence, or cloud technologies
  • Proven success managing high-touch engagements with enterprise customers

job.title: Senior Analyst
job.description:
Senior Analyst, Renewals & Revenue Operations Analytics

Overview

Drive the data, models, and insights behind critical renewal decisions in this hands-on Senior Analyst contract role. You’ll build and maintain the FY’27 Available to Renew (ATR) model, support a weekly renewal forecasting process, and partner with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations stakeholders to improve forecast accuracy and data integrity.

This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong business intelligence or analytics professional with experience in data warehouses, business systems, and recurring forecasting workflows. You’ll work closely with account owners and business leaders to ensure reporting reflects real-world account activity while translating complex data into clear, leadership-ready analysis.

Required Skills

  • Five or more years of experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, business intelligence, or a similar go-to-market analytics role.
  • Experience building or owning a recurring forecasting process.
  • Deep Salesforce and Snowflake experience, particularly with renewal opportunities, quoting, and record linking.
  • Ability to identify and resolve data issues, including linking gaps, debooks, amendments, and unlinked renewal data.
  • Working fluency with Google Colab or a comparable notebook-based scripting environment; Python experience is preferred.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting analytics workflows using tools such as Alteryx.
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills.
  • Ability to build, test, validate, maintain, and document forecasting models and workflows.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain forecast movement and account-level changes in concise narratives for senior leaders.
  • Comfort working within a weekly forecasting cadence and delivering accurate inputs despite imperfect or changing data.
  • Ability to work independently with limited ramp time, prioritize competing requests, and document work thoroughly.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Direct experience building or maintaining an Available to Renew model or comparable renewal-tracking model.
  • Experience supporting a SaaS or education technology renewals organization.
  • Background in renewals analytics, sales operations, or revenue operations.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience supporting renewal-save initiatives or at-risk account analysis.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce corrections, forecast walks, week-over-week dashboards, and leadership forecasting tools.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • The available job information does not specify a preferred educational background.
  • Five or more years of relevant experience in renewals operations, revenue operations, sales operations, business intelligence, or a comparable analytics function is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote; candidates may work from any time zone.
  • Engagement: Contract role initially planned for three months, with a strong likelihood of extension beyond one year.
  • Build, validate, and document the FY’27 ATR model so it can be maintained by the broader team.
  • Refresh and troubleshoot the ATR data pull and associated notebook-based workflows.
  • Support weekly renewal forecasts, forecast walks, dashboard updates, and forecasting tools used by business leaders.
  • Partner effectively with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical requests and provide timely, accurate deliverables.
  • Maintain strong documentation to support effective knowledge transfer at the end of the engagement.

This role partners closely with Real Estate, Construction, Store Operations, Design, landlords, architects, consultants, and other stakeholders to develop practical, high-quality planning solutions.   • Operational requirements and department adjacencies
  • Architectural principles and construction processes

  • Building systems, lease requirements, accessibility standards, and applicable building codes
  • Experience evaluating sites and developing preliminary planning solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional teams and external project partners.

job.title: Senior Accountant - Revenue and Reporting
job.description:
Senior Accountant – Revenue & Reporting

Overview

A healthcare organization in Fremont, CA, is seeking a detail-oriented Senior Accountant – Revenue & Reporting to support revenue accounting, financial reporting, reimbursement analysis, and regulatory activities. This role will play an important part in analyzing net patient service revenue, maintaining contractual allowance and reserve calculations, reconciling patient accounts receivable activity, and preparing clear, accurate financial reporting for management review.

The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, advanced Excel expertise, analytical judgment, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Revenue Cycle, Finance, audit, and regulatory teams. This is a hybrid, contract-to-hire opportunity with an anticipated initial contract period of two to three months.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze monthly net patient service revenue, calculate contractual allowances, and prepare related revenue adjustment journal entries.
  • Conduct revenue analysis and prepare explanations for monthly and year-to-date budget-to-actual variances.
  • Assist with maintaining and refining contractual allowance models, revenue reserve calculations, and related accounting methodologies.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle and Finance teams to research and resolve reimbursement discrepancies, payment issues, and other revenue-related matters.
  • Perform general ledger reconciliations, including patient accounts receivable reserves, contractual allowances, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports, account schedules, and supporting documentation for management review.
  • Reconcile the Epic accounts receivable subledger to the general ledger on a monthly basis, researching and resolving discrepancies as needed.
  • Support the annual financial audit process by preparing audit schedules, compiling supporting documentation, and responding to auditor inquiries.
  • Prepare and coordinate supporting schedules for Medicare and Medicaid cost reports.
  • Assist with regulatory filings, including HCAI reports and other reimbursement-related submissions.
  • Provide support for reimbursement audits, desk reviews, and inquiries from governmental and regulatory agencies.
  • Cross-train and provide support in other functional areas as needed.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive financial and organizational information.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • At least three years of public accounting experience or healthcare/hospital accounting experience.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex financial data and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Positive, proactive, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Sound judgment when communicating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Consistent reliability, punctuality, and attendance.
  • Ability to accept direction and feedback constructively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Healthcare accounting, hospital finance, reimbursement, or revenue cycle experience.
  • Familiarity with hospital reimbursement methodologies, contractual allowances, and net patient revenue accounting.
  • Experience using Workday Financials and Epic.
  • CPA certification or active progress toward CPA licensure.
  • Experience supporting Medicare and Medicaid cost reports, HCAI reports, reimbursement audits, or regulatory reviews.
  • Public accounting experience with healthcare clients.
  • Experience preparing audit schedules and supporting annual financial audits.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline required.
  • Three or more years of relevant public accounting or healthcare/hospital accounting experience required.
  • Healthcare accounting, hospital reimbursement, and revenue reporting experience strongly preferred.
  • CPA certification or progress toward CPA licensure preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid; onsite in Fremont, CA, three days per week.
  • Employment type: Contract-to-hire, with an anticipated initial contract period of two to three months.
  • Must be able to handle confidential financial and organizational information with discretion.
  • Must communicate professionally and tailor the level of detail to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Must be willing to cross-train and provide support in other functional areas as needed.

job.title: International Payroll Specialist - Japan
job.description:
International Payroll Specialist – Japan

Overview

Support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations for employees in Japan in this hands-on, fully remote role. Working approximately 20–25 hours per week, you will manage the monthly Japan payroll cycle in partnership with a local provider, coordinate closely with Japan-based HR teams, respond to employee questions in Japanese and English, and help stabilize the Workday-to-Breeze integration.

This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented payroll professional who can work independently, manage recurring deadlines, protect confidential employee information, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the monthly Japan payroll cycle in Breeze and SmartHR in collaboration with the local payroll provider.
  • Transfer payroll files and employee data between Workday and Breeze.
  • Download payroll reports from SmartHR and upload required information into Breeze.
  • Verify payroll codes, employee inputs, salary data, allowance information, and wage data before each upload.
  • Coordinate with HR in Japan regarding timesheet entries and payroll deadlines.
  • Onboard new employees into payroll systems and support accurate data flow through the Workday-to-Breeze integration.
  • Test and help stabilize workflows across Workday, Breeze, SmartHR, and the payroll provider.
  • Respond to employee payroll questions in Japanese and English through the payroll inbox and Slack.
  • Reconcile monthly payroll reports against Workday and resolve discrepancies with the payroll provider.
  • Prepare inputs for the December year-end adjustment, or nenmatsu chosei.
  • Support social insurance, labor insurance, and resident tax updates throughout the year.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation and the Japan payroll runbook.
  • Provide support for international payroll operations across other APAC markets as needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Five or more years of payroll processing experience, including hands-on experience supporting payroll in Japan.
  • Ability to read and speak Japanese, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both Japanese and English.
  • Working knowledge of Japanese payroll practices, including:
  • Health and pension insurance
  • Employment insurance
  • Income tax withholding
  • Resident tax
  • Year-end adjustment, or nenmatsu chosei
  • Strong attention to detail when handling payroll data, employee inputs, wage information, and payroll codes.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality with employee and payroll information.
  • Ability to independently manage recurring payroll tasks within a part-time schedule.
  • Strong coordination skills when working with HR teams, employees, and payroll providers.
  • Experience reconciling payroll data and investigating or resolving discrepancies.
  • Ability to respond clearly and promptly to payroll questions in Japanese and English.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Freee, Breeze, or SmartHR.
  • Experience with Workday reporting, integrations, and international payroll workflows.
  • Experience supporting international payroll across APAC markets.
  • Experience coordinating with local payroll providers in multiple countries.
  • Experience supporting high-growth startups or rapidly scaling international teams.
  • Experience developing payroll documentation, runbooks, and standardized procedures.
  • Experience testing and stabilizing payroll system integrations.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Five or more years of relevant payroll processing experience, including Japan payroll operations.
  • Experience supporting payroll system integrations, data transfers, reporting, and monthly reconciliations.
  • A preferred educational background was not specified; demonstrated expertise in Japan payroll practices and relevant hands-on experience are valued.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Schedule: Part-time, approximately 20–25 hours per week.
  • Ability to manage recurring payroll deadlines and work independently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Japan-based HR partners, payroll providers, and international teams.
  • Successful completion of a background check is required.
  • Must be able to handle confidential employee information in accordance with applicable local requirements.

job.title: Sr. Data and Automation Engineer, Enterprise Applications
job.description:
Sr. Data and Automation Engineer, Enterprise Applications

Overview

Build the data products and automation that help critical business teams make faster, more informed decisions. As a hands-on Senior Data and Automation Engineer, you will connect enterprise applications across Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations using Databricks, Snowflake, and related analytics platforms.

You will work independently with business stakeholders to transform complex requirements into trusted, governed datasets, reliable integrations, actionable dashboards, and scalable automation. This six-month engagement is focused on delivering documented data products and sustainable solutions that long-term support teams can confidently maintain.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Curated, documented data products supporting use cases such as expense management, learning analytics, gross-to-net reporting, budgeting, and operational reporting.
  • Reliable pipelines and integrations connecting enterprise applications and third-party sources to governed datasets.
  • Dashboards, metrics, and reporting products for broad General and Administrative (G&A) functions.
  • Data quality checks, definitions, documentation, and standards that make enterprise data accessible and trustworthy.
  • Automation and integration solutions—or clearly defined roadmaps—to reduce manual data preparation, reconciliation, reporting, and workflow handoffs.
  • Handoff documentation and support-ready solutions designed to remain adaptable as enterprise systems evolve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of curated data products across Databricks, Snowflake, and related platforms.
  • Develop ingestion, transformation, data quality, and reusable data modeling solutions.
  • Partner with G&A business owners to define analytics requirements, key performance indicators, data definitions, and priority use cases.
  • Build pipelines and integrations using APIs, flat files, middleware, Fivetran or similar ingestion tools, and third-party data sources.
  • Create dashboards, metrics layers, and insight products for functions including Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations.
  • Establish standards for data naming, lineage, documentation, access controls, data quality, and long-term support handoff.
  • Identify and deliver automation opportunities using Workato, Moveworks, middleware, or similar platforms.
  • Evaluate and responsibly apply artificial intelligence tools to simplify processes, improve data stewardship, and accelerate analytics delivery.
  • Collaborate with Information Security, Compliance, Legal, and data owners to protect sensitive information and align with privacy, governance, and access requirements.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake
  • SQL
  • Python or PySpark
  • Delta Lake
  • Fivetran or similar data ingestion tools
  • Modern data lakehouse or data warehouse patterns
  • Experience designing curated datasets, semantic models, data quality rules, and documentation for business users.
  • Experience integrating enterprise data through APIs, flat files, middleware, or integration platform as a service (iPaaS) tools.
  • Experience with reporting platforms and reverse extract, transform, load (reverse ETL) or data activation patterns.
  • Familiarity with G&A processes and systems, including NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, Workday Adaptive, Ironclad, Emtrain, ComplianceWire, or similar platforms supporting Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Legal, learning, compliance, or planning functions.
  • Experience using Workato, Moveworks, middleware, iPaaS, or comparable automation and integration platforms.
  • Ability to convert complex or ambiguous business needs into practical technical requirements and delivery plans.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with business, technology, compliance, and security partners.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ERP platforms beyond NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting system migrations or re-pointing integrations and data pipelines as applications change.
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience delivering analytics across multiple G&A functions, including expense management, learning, and workforce metrics.
  • Experience with Unity Catalog, Snowflake governance, workflow orchestration, data lineage, data governance, or access management.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative AI to analytics workflows, automation, knowledge retrieval, or operational process improvement.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, enterprise analytics, business systems, integration, automation, or data product delivery.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid in Redwood City, California.
  • Engagement: Six-month contract with potential to convert.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Ability to work with sensitive enterprise data in alignment with applicable privacy, governance, security, and access requirements.

job.title: AI Product Video Creator
job.description:
AI Product Video Creator

Overview

Create the videos that make cutting-edge AI products impossible to ignore. As an AI Product Video Creator, you’ll transform working AI applications, tools, games, and web prototypes into polished, high-energy demo videos designed to stop the scroll and drive social engagement.

You’ll own the creative video process from recording and editing through sound design and final export. Your work will showcase the capabilities of interactive AI products through seamless motion, crisp pacing, intentional visual storytelling, and premium production quality—capturing attention within the first two seconds.

You will not be expected to write code. Technical AI builders will provide functional interactive products; your role is to bring those creations to life through compelling visuals and ready-to-post social content.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience creating software demos, technology showcases, feature launches, or tech sizzle reels.
  • Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end video creation, including two to three examples that generated strong organic engagement.
  • Exceptional eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, camera choreography, typography, and sound design.
  • Expertise with one or more professional video and motion-design tools, such as:
  • Screen Studio
  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Final Cut Pro
  • CapCut
  • Ability to transform raw screen captures into polished, premium social content.
  • Strong understanding of visual hooks, including the ability to create compelling 0–3-second openings.
  • Ability to navigate web applications, developer tools, and interactive prototypes to identify effective recording angles.
  • Strong attention to capture quality, including smooth frame rates and clean footage without visible lag, stutter, glitches, or distracting interface elements.
  • Ability to independently manage recording, editing, sound, and final exports.
  • Ability to deliver ready-to-post videos within a 24–48-hour turnaround after receiving a working prototype and creative brief.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience creating content specifically for X or other social media feeds.
  • Experience producing viral or high-performing technology product content.
  • Familiarity with AI applications, interactive tools, games, or early-stage web prototypes.
  • Advanced motion graphics, sound-design, and visual-effects skills.
  • Experience developing repeatable workflows for rapid video production.
  • Experience with 2D or 3D animation, color grading, or compositing.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative production workflows.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Degree or formal training in video production, film, motion design, graphic design, digital media, or a related field is preferred.
  • Professional experience creating technology-focused social video content is preferred.
  • A portfolio featuring completed software demos, product videos, or technology sizzle reels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience taking video projects from concept through final delivery is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Not specified in the provided job details.
  • Must be able to work quickly and independently in a high-output creative environment.
  • Must be comfortable working from functional prototypes and translating product capabilities into clear, visually engaging demonstrations.
  • Must be able to provide two to three end-to-end software demos or technology sizzle reels as portfolio samples.
  • Must be prepared to describe the tools and techniques used to elevate raw screen captures into premium social content.
  • Must be able to commit to a 24–48-hour turnaround from receipt of a working prototype to delivery of a ready-to-post video.

job.title: Procurement Operations Specialist
job.description:
Procurement Operations Specialist

Overview

Support critical procurement operations for a leading SaaS organization as a Procurement Operations Specialist. This contract role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who can manage purchasing requests, supplier and invoice follow-up, procurement tickets, and purchase order workflows while helping improve team efficiency through practical applications of artificial intelligence.

Working closely with procurement and cross-functional stakeholders, you will keep daily operations organized, responsive, and accurate while contributing to the adoption of approved AI tools and streamlined workflows.

Required Skills

  • Professional experience in procurement operations, purchasing, or a related function
  • Experience managing procurement requests and resolving service or support tickets
  • Knowledge of purchase orders, supplier coordination, invoice follow-up, and routine purchasing activities
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage ticket queues, documentation, and handoffs
  • High level of accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail
  • Experience using procurement, purchasing, or enterprise business systems
  • Practical experience with artificial intelligence tools or AI-enabled workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Freshworks or a similar ticketing platform
  • Experience with Coupa or another procurement management system
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT or Claude
  • Experience reviewing contracts, statements of work, or business terms
  • Experience testing AI use cases, documenting workflows, or supporting AI adoption
  • SaaS industry experience
  • Familiarity with supplier onboarding, purchase requisitions, or procure-to-pay processes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, procurement, finance, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience in procurement operations, purchasing, accounts payable support, or supplier management preferred
  • Experience supporting process improvement or system implementation initiatives is beneficial

Other Requirements

  • Contract position expected to last approximately 3–4 months
  • Hybrid schedule with three days onsite each week: Tuesday through Thursday
  • Work location options: Austen, TX, or Waltham, MA
  • Candidates working from the Waltham location must be available during Eastern Time hours
  • Ability to work a full-time, 40-hour workweek
  • Target start date: December 1
  • Background check and drug screening required

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Data Engineer

Overview

Support a high-priority data initiative focused on call center operations as a Data Engineer. In this project-based role, you will use Python, Snowflake, SQL Server, and REST APIs to integrate, analyze, and organize operational data—transforming complex information into accurate, actionable insights. You will collaborate closely with call center contractors and project stakeholders while contributing technical expertise to a time-sensitive initiative with meaningful operational impact.

Required Skills

  • 7–10 years of professional experience with Python
  • 7–10 years of experience writing Snowflake SQL
  • 7–10 years of experience working with Microsoft SQL Server SQL
  • Experience developing or working with REST APIs
  • Experience in data engineering, data analysis, or a closely related field
  • Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple systems
  • Strong data analysis, reporting, and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with technical and operational teams
  • Ability to communicate technical information and data findings clearly

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in the banking or credit union industry
  • Experience supporting call center performance, operations, or workforce data
  • Experience with API-driven data projects
  • Familiarity with contractor-supported operations
  • Experience translating complex datasets into actionable business insights

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 7–10 years of professional experience with Python, Snowflake SQL, and SQL Server SQL
  • Professional background in data engineering, data analysis, operational analytics, or a related discipline
  • Experience supporting call center data or operational analytics is preferred
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided

Other Requirements

  • Project-based contract expected to last approximately 3–4 months
  • Ability to support an urgent, high-priority project
  • Ability to collaborate closely with four call center contractors and other project stakeholders
  • Remote or onsite work arrangement was not specified
  • No specific certification or travel requirements were provided

job.title: AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus
job.description:
AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus

Overview

Build the next generation of intelligent business applications as an AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus. This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience developing and deploying production-grade AI agents.

You’ll partner with product managers and domain experts to understand complex workflows, define success criteria, and transform business challenges into reliable agentic solutions. From designing multi-agent workflows and integrating tools to deploying scalable backend services and continuously improving production performance, you’ll own solutions from discovery through implementation and ongoing optimization.

Required Skills

  • Approximately 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on backend development and production systems.
  • Approximately 2+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents or agent-powered production applications using code.
  • Strong backend development experience with Python.
  • Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM APIs and SDKs
  • AI agent frameworks
  • Multi-agent orchestration
  • Tool calling
  • Context and state management
  • Agent execution workflows
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying:
  • Production-grade backend services
  • REST APIs
  • External and internal integrations
  • Data models
  • Strong understanding of system design, API design, algorithms, data structures, access control, and scalable application architecture.
  • Experience building reliable agent workflows with retries, caching, error handling, evaluations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
  • Experience integrating AI agents with business systems, internal platforms, APIs, and external tools.
  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, and staged deployments.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Demonstrated ownership of solutions from requirements discovery and workflow design through deployment and production support.
  • Ability to communicate proactively, clarify requirements, collaborate with stakeholders, and work effectively through ambiguity.
  • Ability to measure and improve outcomes such as time saved, errors reduced, and process efficiency.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Frontend development experience with JavaScript ES6+ and React.
  • Experience using Claude Code or other AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Google ADK or LangGraph.
  • Experience developing Electron-based desktop applications.
  • Knowledge of API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Basic DevOps experience, including Docker and CI/CD.
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing AI agents with real users and measurable production outcomes.
  • Ability to determine when an AI agent is appropriate versus a simpler automation approach.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field is preferred; specific educational requirements were not provided.
  • Approximately 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial backend development.
  • Approximately 2+ years of experience building and deploying AI agents or agent-powered applications in production environments.

Other Requirements

  • Location: Palo Alto, CA.
  • Work arrangement: Remote or onsite status was not specified in the provided role details.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Duration: 3 months.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Engineering Technician, Powertrain
job.description:
Engineering Technician, Powertrain

Overview

Join a hands-on hardware engineering team developing and testing advanced autonomous systems. As an Engineering Technician, Powertrain, you will build, modify, test, and troubleshoot complex electromechanical assemblies, wiring harnesses, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), and high-voltage powertrain hardware.

Your work will support prototyping, validation, system testing, and the development of reliable next-generation technology. This opportunity is ideal for a technically versatile, growth-minded professional who enjoys solving challenging hardware problems, collaborating with engineers, and turning test results into actionable improvements.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated mid-to-high-level soldering proficiency, including:
  • Fine-pitch soldering
  • Surface-mount rework
  • Harness fabrication
  • Crimping and pinning
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering schematics, mechanical drawings, and wiring diagrams.
  • Experience building, reworking, and modifying electromechanical assemblies, wiring harnesses, and PCBAs.
  • Experience executing hardware tests and troubleshooting electrical systems.
  • Ability to use electrical measurement equipment, including multimeters and oscilloscopes.
  • Familiarity with command-line interface tools and engineering development environments used to configure, test, or troubleshoot hardware.
  • Ability to review test data and logs, conduct systematic root-cause analysis, and document findings clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to following engineering documentation and test procedures.
  • Self-motivated, solution-oriented approach with the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and specialized hardware teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience testing high-voltage, high-power battery or powertrain systems.
  • Familiarity with surface-mount technology rework under magnification.
  • Experience building test fixtures, mechanical test rigs, or ground-support hardware.
  • Background in mechanical assembly, PCBA work, or complex hardware test operations.
  • Experience operating complex engineering tests and communicating clear, actionable results to engineering teams.
  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or hardware prototyping environments.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred experience includes hands-on work in an engineering, automotive, aerospace, robotics, autonomous vehicle, or hardware prototyping environment.
  • Demonstrated practical proficiency with soldering, electrical testing, hardware troubleshooting, engineering documentation, and command-line or development tools.
  • No specific educational requirement was provided.

Other Requirements

  • Location: Onsite/hybrid in the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Employment Type: W2 contract-to-hire.
  • Duration: Initial six-month contract with potential for full-time conversion.
  • Ability to work in a hands-on engineering test and development environment.
  • Must be comfortable performing practical hardware work, including soldering, harness fabrication, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • High-voltage, high-power, and engineering test experience may be required for certain powertrain assignments.

job.title: Technical Program Manager — New Product Development (Hardware)
job.description:
Technical Program Manager — New Product Development (Hardware)

Overview

Lead the development of next-generation autonomous vehicle hardware from early concept and architecture through engineering builds and production ramp. As a Technical Program Manager, you will own end-to-end program execution for complex hardware products, coordinating teams across hardware, software, firmware, functional safety, systems engineering, procurement, and vehicle development.

You will translate strategic objectives into actionable roadmaps, schedules, milestones, and deliverables while partnering closely with internal engineering organizations and external contract manufacturers. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, proactive risk management, clear communication, and the ability to influence outcomes across teams without formal authority.

This is an opportunity to help deliver challenging, highly integrated hardware systems in a fast-moving environment where structured program management and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in hardware Technical Program Management or Engineering Program Management.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end hardware development experience, taking products from concept through:
  • Engineering Validation Test (EVT)
  • Design Validation Test (DVT)
  • Production Validation Test (PVT)
  • Production ramp
  • Strong hardware background with a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline—or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with outside contract manufacturers through development builds and production ramp.
  • Ability to coordinate complex programs across hardware, software, firmware, functional safety, systems engineering, procurement, and vehicle development teams.
  • Experience developing program schedules, product roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and dependency plans.
  • Strong risk identification, mitigation, and issue-resolution skills, including the ability to drive actions to closure.
  • Ability to communicate program status, accomplishments, issues, and risks clearly and concisely to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Experience establishing standard program reports and maintaining clear visibility into progress and risks.
  • Proficiency with tools used to manage complex programs, such as JIRA and Gantt charts.
  • Ability to set agendas and facilitate key decisions that eliminate bottlenecks and minimize program risk.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to remain flexible and composed while working through rapid development cycles and uncertainty.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating across multiple cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority and build strong working relationships with engineering teams, contract manufacturers, and senior leaders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • End-to-end hardware development experience in the automotive or consumer electronics industry at the system or subsystem level.
  • Direct management of two or more complete program development cycles involving hardware and software integration.
  • Technical Program Management experience supporting production programs during mass production and post-production sustaining phases.
  • Experience incorporating design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test feedback into hardware development.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional decisions involving engineering, finance, and strategy.
  • Strong references demonstrating the ability to build effective working relationships with senior leaders and engineers across functions and departments.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Six or more years of hardware Technical Program Management or Engineering Program Management experience.
  • Experience leading hardware programs through concept, architecture, EVT, DVT, PVT, and production ramp.
  • A master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering is a plus.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite.
  • Location: Foster City, California.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 12 months.
  • Must be able to partner effectively with external contract manufacturers and cross-functional internal teams throughout hardware development and production ramp.
  • Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and taking on a broad range of responsibilities as program needs evolve.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager – Professional Services

Overview

Lead complex customer engagements from kickoff through successful delivery and formal closeout. As a customer-facing Project Manager on a Professional Services team, you’ll guide implementation, migration, and professional services projects across technology and security solutions. You’ll manage a portfolio of 15–20 concurrent mid-size to large engagements, partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to maintain momentum, resolve issues, and deliver measurable results.

This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized project leader who can balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

Required Skills
