  • 5+ years of project management experience, including 3+ years managing customer-facing projects in professional services, consulting, implementation delivery, technology, or SaaS environments
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent projects with accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and customer satisfaction
  • Hands-on experience delivering projects under a Statement of Work (SOW) or Service Delivery Description (SDD)
  • Experience managing change requests, project financials, hours, burn rates, and forecasting
  • Working knowledge of waterfall, agile, and hybrid delivery methodologies, as well as PMI/PMBOK practices
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage customer stakeholders through the director level
  • Experience leading escalations and navigating difficult conversations with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Proven ability to identify risks early, provide clear recommendations, and drive issues through resolution
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive sense of ownership in an evolving environment
  • Technical literacy in networking and security concepts, such as DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS, and Zero Trust/SASE
  • Ability to understand technical discussions, migration dependencies, and project delivery risks
  • Proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, and a professional services automation (PSA) tool such as Certinia, Kantata, or ServiceNow SPM
  • Experience using Smartsheet or Microsoft Project
  • Ability to coordinate consultants, solutions engineers, account executives, customer success teams, support teams, partners, and customer stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • PMP or CAPM certification
  • Agile certification, such as PMI-ACP, CSM, or SAFe
  • Professional services delivery experience with a cybersecurity, networking, or cloud provider
  • Experience migrating customers from competing CDN, security, or SASE vendors
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline project management activities, including status reporting and meeting documentation
  • Experience managing migration, cutover, and technology implementation risks

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, or a related field
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree
  • 5+ years of project management experience, with a focus on customer-facing technology, SaaS, consulting, implementation, or professional services engagements

Other Requirements

  • Austin, TX is preferred; fully remote candidates may be considered
  • W2 engagement only
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of 15–20 concurrent engagements from kickoff through formal closure
  • Ability to lead customer governance activities, including kickoff meetings, project plans, status reports, RAID logs, and executive updates
  • Ability to secure formal customer acceptance and sign-off for completed deliverables
  • Ability to maintain accurate project records and reporting across Jira, Salesforce, and PSA systems

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:
Senior Financial Analyst – Corporate FP&A

Overview

Support high-impact Corporate FP&A initiatives in a project-based contract role focused on strengthening capital planning, capital allocation, and financial reporting processes. You will evaluate existing workflows, design standardized processes and governance, improve capital tracking, and develop management tools that help business leaders make informed decisions.

This role is well suited for an analytical, independent finance professional who can manage complex deliverables, collaborate across business functions and regions, and identify opportunities to improve reporting and automation. Additional projects may include working capital, long-range planning, financial modeling, reporting automation, and broader finance process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Strong background in corporate FP&A or corporate finance
  • Experience with capital planning, capital allocation, or CAPEX management
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills
  • Experience preparing financial reports and management reporting tools
  • Ability to assess existing processes and develop standardized workflows
  • Ability to independently manage project-based deliverables
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple business functions and regions

Nice to Have Skills

  • Power BI experience
  • Power Automate experience
  • Broader Microsoft 365 experience
  • Experience developing dashboards and management tools
  • Experience identifying opportunities for finance process automation
  • Background supporting working capital or long-range planning initiatives

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Prior experience in corporate FP&A, financial planning, corporate finance, or a related field
  • Experience leading or contributing to finance transformation, process improvement, capital management, or reporting projects
  • Educational requirements were not specified for this position

Other Requirements

  • Contract position with an initial estimated duration of 2+ months and potential for extension
  • Hybrid schedule based in Fairhaven, MA
  • Onsite presence required three days per week: Monday or Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday
  • Full-time schedule of 40 hours per week
  • Flexible start and end times
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible

job.title: AP Consultant
job.description:
AP Consultant (Part-Time, Fully Remote)

Overview

A fast-growing technology organization is seeking an experienced AP Consultant to support increasing accounts payable volume and evolving accounting needs. This hands-on consultant will take ownership of day-to-day AP processing, expense management, and related accounting activities while working independently in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and confident managing the full AP workflow remotely. This role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately, collaborate with a supportive accounting team, and potentially take on additional hours and accounting projects as business needs evolve.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on accounts payable experience, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment
  • Experience processing and coding vendor bills, credit card transactions, and employee reimbursements
  • Strong understanding of general ledger coding and transaction review
  • Ability to verify supporting documentation and maintain accurate AP records
  • Experience following up with employees and vendors to resolve missing receipts, invoices, and discrepancies
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities
  • Proactive communication skills and the ability to identify and escalate issues appropriately
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
  • Ability to quickly learn company-specific accounting processes and software

Nice to Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Ramp
  • Experience with AP automation workflows and corporate card platforms
  • Experience with vendor onboarding, vendor statement reconciliation, payment processing, and AP aging review
  • Familiarity with expense management processes
  • Experience supporting additional accounting projects
  • Experience working in a startup or rapidly growing company

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred
  • Proven experience in a full-cycle or high-volume accounts payable role
  • Experience supporting accounting operations in a technology or SaaS organization preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Part-time, typically 20–25 hours per week; hours may increase to 30–35 per week depending on workload
  • Duration: 3–6 months, with the possibility of extension
  • Additional opportunities: Ad hoc accounting projects may create opportunities for additional hours
  • Start timing: Ideally available to begin within approximately two weeks
  • Must be comfortable managing AP responsibilities independently in a remote work environment

job.title: Tax Contractor (Indirect and International Tax) - Part Time
job.description:
Tax Contractor (Indirect and International Tax) — Part Time

Overview

A fast-growing, global consumption-based SaaS organization is seeking an experienced, hands-on Tax Contractor to strengthen its tax operations during a period of continued international growth. This role will focus primarily on indirect and international tax, including assessing sales and use tax, VAT, and GST exposure; coordinating tax registrations; and ensuring customer contracts, order forms, and billing reflect appropriate tax treatment.

The contractor will also support domestic and international income tax compliance, year-end tax activities, audit preparation, and additional tax initiatives as needed. This is an opportunity for a Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager to work independently, collaborate with finance and billing stakeholders, manage external tax advisors, and establish practical processes that can transition to a future permanent tax leader.

Part-time work is preferred, averaging approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility based on project needs. Candidates available for full-time hours may also be considered.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager-level experience
  • Strong indirect tax experience, including sales and use tax, VAT, and GST
  • Substantial international tax experience, including cross-border tax exposure assessments
  • Ability to evaluate whether tax registrations are required in additional jurisdictions
  • Experience coordinating country-specific registrations with external tax advisors
  • Knowledge of tax considerations in customer contracts, order forms, and billing, including:
  • Tax allocation
  • Gross-up provisions
  • Withholding language
  • Invoicing requirements
  • Experience supporting year-end tax compliance and tax-related audit requests
  • Experience with indirect tax filings, reconciliations, exemption certificates, and tax notices
  • Ability to support refund claims, voluntary disclosures, and other remediation projects
  • Familiarity with international tax matters such as permanent establishment, withholding tax, and cross-border structuring
  • Experience overseeing outsourced R&D tax and transfer pricing projects
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with transaction-level data and financial systems
  • Experience managing external tax advisors and translating recommendations into actionable next steps
  • Ability to work independently while helping establish an evolving internal tax function
  • Clear communication, strong organization, and the ability to manage multiple projects on a flexible schedule

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting a growing technology or SaaS organization with international operations
  • Familiarity with indirect tax considerations in customer contracts and order forms
  • Experience with Anrok
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online, Rillet, and Stripe
  • Experience establishing tax calendars, documentation, controls, and repeatable processes
  • Experience supporting organizations preparing for public-company readiness

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Several years of progressive tax experience, including Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager-level responsibilities
  • Demonstrated experience across indirect tax, international tax, tax compliance, and tax advisory projects
  • Relevant education or professional credentials in tax, accounting, finance, or a related discipline are beneficial; specific education and certification requirements were not provided

Other Requirements

  • Schedule: Part-time preferred, averaging approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible scheduling based on project needs
  • Full-time consideration: Candidates available for full-time hours may also be considered
  • Engagement duration: Part-time work is expected to continue through February. Full-time engagements are expected to last approximately 1–2 months. Extensions may be possible based on project needs and the timing of a permanent tax hire.
  • Workload: Hours may be higher early in the engagement during the exposure assessment, registration activities, year-end work, and audit preparation, then taper as processes stabilize
  • Systems environment: The organization is transitioning from QuickBooks Online to Rillet; historical information and other project work may require access to QuickBooks Online
  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with internal finance, billing, and tax stakeholders, as well as external tax providers
  • Scheduling consideration: Work should be planned around the organization’s scheduled closure from 12/21 through 01/03
  • Work arrangement: Remote, onsite, or hybrid expectations were not specified in the provided details

job.title: Developer Productivity Engineer
job.description:
Developer Productivity Engineer

Overview

Help engineering teams unlock the full value of AI-powered development tools in this hands-on Developer Productivity Engineer role. You’ll serve as a trusted advocate for developers, supporting adoption of a coding AI platform, resolving user challenges, analyzing engagement data, and partnering with engineering and AI platform teams to improve the overall developer experience.

This role is ideal for a technically capable professional who enjoys working at the intersection of developer tools, AI enablement, technical support, analytics, and cross-functional collaboration. Rather than focusing solely on software development, you’ll help engineers successfully adopt emerging technologies and translate usage insights into measurable productivity improvements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience supporting developer tools, engineering platforms, DevOps environments, or developer productivity initiatives
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience administering, supporting, or enabling developer-facing tools and platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding technologies, large language models (LLMs), and AI agents
  • Knowledge of AI coding tools and their application within software development workflows
  • Experience working with developer environments such as VS Code and related integrations
  • Programming experience in one or more of the following:
  • Python
  • Go
  • Java
  • Experience with dashboarding, analytics, or monitoring platforms such as Grafana or Kibana
  • Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, or similar ticketing and support systems
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple engineering teams
  • Ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable solutions

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive awareness, onboarding, and adoption of AI-powered coding tools across engineering teams
  • Support installation, configuration, and ongoing usage of the platform
  • Serve as a primary support and escalation point for engineers using the platform
  • Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate with platform teams on complex technical problems
  • Create and maintain onboarding materials, FAQs, knowledge base articles, documentation, and training resources
  • Gather developer feedback and recommend improvements to the user experience
  • Track adoption, usage patterns, engagement, and platform effectiveness
  • Build dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into key performance indicators and trends
  • Analyze usage data to identify adoption challenges and opportunities to improve developer productivity
  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI platform teams on bug resolution, feature requests, and enhancements
  • Communicate insights, trends, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership
  • Help ensure platform usage aligns with security, access management, and governance requirements

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting internal engineering platforms at scale
  • Experience driving adoption of new developer technologies or enterprise tools
  • Strong customer service and relationship-management skills
  • Experience creating developer enablement programs, technical documentation, or training
  • Familiarity with platform governance, access management, or security requirements
  • Experience measuring business impact through adoption metrics and usage analytics
  • Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and their practical applications in software development
  • A proactive approach to identifying issues, improving processes, and delivering measurable outcomes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered
  • Approximately 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in developer productivity, developer tools, engineering platforms, DevOps support, or a related area

Other Requirements

  • Contract position with an approximately 9-month duration
  • Hybrid role based in San Jose, California
  • Onsite attendance required three days per week
  • W2 employment only
  • Ability to work effectively with distributed engineering, product, and platform stakeholders
  • Strong interest in helping engineering teams adopt and benefit from AI-powered development tools

job.title: Treasurer
job.description:
Corporate Treasurer

Overview

Lead the treasury function for a complex, growing organization during a period of significant integration and operational change. The Corporate Treasurer will oversee global liquidity, banking relationships, credit facilities, foreign exchange exposure, working capital planning, insurance, and financial risk management.

This highly visible role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CFO and Board while ensuring the organization has the funding, controls, and risk protections needed to execute its business plans. The ideal candidate brings a strategic mindset, strong technical expertise, and the hands-on leadership needed to build scalable treasury processes across multiple entities, currencies, banks, and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own global cash management, daily cash positioning, liquidity reporting, and entity-level funding.
  • Lead the 13-week direct cash forecast and longer-range liquidity outlook by entity, currency, and use of cash.
  • Oversee payments, bank reconciliations, cash concentration, intercompany funding, and settlement activities.
  • Evaluate cash pooling, netting, repatriation, and other liquidity strategies while accounting for local restrictions.
  • Manage surplus cash in accordance with approved investment policies and counterparty limits.
  • Establish and execute the organization’s bank group strategy.
  • Manage banking relationships, account structures, KYC requirements, signatory mandates, service evaluations, RFPs, and fee negotiations.
  • Monitor bank and investment counterparty credit quality and exposure limits.
  • Develop and maintain the foreign exchange risk management policy.
  • Identify currency exposures and execute appropriate hedges, including forwards, swaps, options, spot conversions, and natural offsets.
  • Manage credit facilities, revolving and term arrangements, guarantees, surety, corporate cards, and other credit lines.
  • Monitor covenant compliance, lender reporting, collateral requirements, borrowing bases, fees, utilization, and available headroom.
  • Lead negotiations for new facilities, amendments, extensions, and refinancings.
  • Partner with FP&A, Procurement, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Operations, and program leadership on working capital planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payment terms, release cash, reduce funding needs, and optimize the cash conversion cycle.
  • Own the global corporate insurance program, including coverage evaluation, renewals, claims, broker and carrier management, and contractual requirements.
  • Report liquidity, funding, FX exposure, credit arrangements, insurance coverage, claims, and financial risk to executive leadership and relevant governance committees.
  • Build scalable treasury processes, controls, systems, and reporting to support continued growth and integration activities.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including:
  • Five or more years in corporate treasury.
  • Three or more years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing:
  • Global cash and liquidity across multiple entities and currencies.
  • Intercompany funding and cash movements.
  • Multi-bank relationships and banking structures.
  • Credit facilities, debt arrangements, covenants, and letters of credit.
  • Experience developing and executing foreign exchange hedging programs.
  • Knowledge of ISDA documentation, derivative accounting, and hedge effectiveness testing under ASC 815.
  • Strong cash forecasting, financial modeling, and working capital analysis skills.
  • Experience negotiating bank fees, cash management services, credit arrangements, and other treasury services.
  • Experience managing corporate insurance programs, including broker and carrier relationships, renewals, claims, and contractual insurance requirements.
  • Ability to develop and maintain treasury policies, approval workflows, segregation-of-duties processes, and fraud controls.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present liquidity, funding, risk, and scenario analyses to executive and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic, hands-on approach with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, integration-focused environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • MBA, Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), CFA, or equivalent advanced credential.
  • ARM, CPCU, or another risk management designation.
  • Experience with aviation, aerospace, products liability, or other specialty insurance programs.
  • Background in a public, high-growth, capital-intensive, manufacturing, or long-lead supply chain organization.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions or transaction integration.
  • Knowledge of cross-border cash restrictions, repatriation, cash pooling, netting, and international banking operations.
  • Experience implementing or improving treasury management systems and bank connectivity, including SWIFT, host-to-host, or API integrations.
  • Familiarity with supply chain finance, trade finance, alternative risk financing, or captive insurance structures.
  • Experience operating within SOX-compliant treasury control environments.

Preferred Education and Experience

The preferred candidate will hold a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline and bring at least 10 years of finance experience, including substantial leadership experience in corporate treasury. Candidates should have a proven record of managing global cash, banking relationships, FX exposure, credit facilities, corporate insurance, working capital, and financial risk for a multi-entity organization.

An MBA, CFA, CTP, ARM, CPCU, or similar credential is advantageous.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite, hybrid, or remote options available.
  • Engagement: Five months or longer, with potential for contract-to-hire.
  • Start timing: Expected to begin between mid-November and early December 2026.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across domestic and international entities, currencies, banks, lenders, and business functions.
  • Strong discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential financial, banking, lending, insurance, and transaction-related information.

job.title: Sr. Accountant
job.description:
Sr. Accountant — Fully Remote

Overview

A leading organization is seeking a detail-oriented Sr. Accountant for a fully remote, approximately 3+ month contract assignment. This role will play a key part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting timely close processes, preparing consolidated financial reporting, and strengthening accounting operations. The ideal candidate brings strong technical accounting expertise, advanced Excel skills, and hands-on experience with NetSuite in a complex organizational environment.

Required Skills

  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes while meeting financial reporting deadlines.
  • Record and review payroll, intercompany transactions, and other period-end activity.
  • Prepare and review consolidated financial statements, including balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Perform complex account reconciliations and investigate variances.
  • Support external audits by coordinating documentation and helping ensure compliance with internal controls.
  • Research and apply relevant accounting standards.
  • Identify and implement improvements to accounting workflows and software utilization.
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables and VLOOKUPs.
  • Possess hands-on experience with NetSuite, which is required for this position.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Communicate effectively while working independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in professional services or advertising.
  • Familiarity with project-based accounting or revenue recognition.
  • Experience working within a mid-to-large-sized organization with complex structures.
  • Experience in a publicly traded company.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience supporting process optimization, accounting system enhancements, or ERP improvements.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with enterprise-level ERP systems, with NetSuite experience required.
  • Background in financial reporting, account reconciliations, audit support, and period-end close activities.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Must be available to work Pacific Time hours, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
  • Availability to start immediately.
  • Contract duration is approximately 3+ months.

job.title: Technical PM
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Site Implementations

Overview

Lead complex, high-impact technology implementations that bring integrated parking solutions to life at new and existing sites. As the Technical Program Manager, you will own each deployment from discovery and kickoff through design, permitting, installation, software configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and operational handoff.

This field-oriented role brings together software, customer-facing hardware, networking, construction, vendors, field teams, and customer operations. You will establish repeatable implementation standards, coordinate cross-functional delivery, manage site readiness, and ensure every launch meets approved scope, quality standards, acceptance criteria, and operational requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience leading complex technology implementations involving software, customer-facing hardware, networking, vendors, and physical site work.
  • Demonstrated ownership of multiple site deployments from initial planning through go-live.
  • Experience managing:
  • Permitting and inspections
  • Construction and site-readiness dependencies
  • Vendor schedules and contractor commitments
  • Procurement, shipping, and equipment installation
  • Quality assurance and customer acceptance
  • Strong working knowledge of software delivery, integrations, defect management, release readiness, and production support.
  • Ability to interpret implementation plans, site drawings, technical requirements, test results, and project financial information well enough to identify gaps and drive decisions.
  • Experience coordinating internal teams, customers, hardware vendors, software teams, utilities, permitting authorities, construction partners, low-voltage contractors, and field installers.
  • Experience managing risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, scope changes, budget impacts, dependencies, and recovery plans.
  • Ability to coordinate functional testing, integration testing, field acceptance testing, user acceptance testing, defect remediation, launch approval, and post-launch support.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, organization, risk management, and executive status-reporting skills.
  • Ability to travel regularly to implementation sites and support critical implementation milestones outside normal business hours when required.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience with parking technology, access control, kiosks, point-of-sale systems, building systems, EV charging, security systems, telecommunications, or other distributed hardware and software environments.
  • Experience with Parking Access and Revenue Control Systems.
  • Familiarity with payment systems, license plate recognition, parking guidance, enforcement, mobile applications, or revenue optimization products.
  • Experience supporting implementations at municipalities, hospitals, hotels, universities, mixed-use properties, airports, or other active customer sites.
  • Project or program management certification.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or comparable project and program management tools.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Education: Preferred education was not specified.
  • Experience: Five or more years leading complex, multi-site technology implementations that combine software, hardware, networking, vendors, and physical site work.

Other Requirements

  • This is a field-oriented implementation role involving active customer sites, installation environments, and coordination with construction, electrical, low-voltage, utility, permitting, and field service partners.
  • Regular travel to implementation sites is required.
  • Availability to support critical implementation milestones outside normal business hours may be required.
  • Establish and continuously improve implementation playbooks, including stage gates, deliverables, decision rights, quality standards, escalation paths, and launch criteria.
  • Coordinate cutover and go-live plans, confirm training and support readiness, complete operational handoff documentation, and use post-launch findings to improve future implementations.

job.title: Software Engineer - Fleet Mapping
job.description:
Software Engineer – Fleet Mapping

Overview

Join a Perception team developing the systems that help autonomous vehicles understand and navigate complex environments. In this role, you will contribute to an offline mapping initiative focused on high-definition semantic maps—an essential component of enabling fully autonomous driving at scale. You will design, train, validate, and integrate machine learning models that detect semantic map elements, while helping build scalable pipelines that automate the mapping of new features.

This is a remote position for candidates located in California, with three openings available.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of professional experience with C++
  • Strong understanding of networking protocols, ideally including UDP
  • Experience working with highly resilient distributed systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to research, implement, and train machine learning models
  • Experience curating, validating, and labeling datasets for model training and validation
  • Ability to integrate models into broader software or data-processing pipelines
  • Strong collaboration skills, including the ability to work closely with validation teams

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in robotics
  • Experience with 3D computer vision
  • Experience with mapping systems or technologies
  • Experience working with machine learning infrastructure
  • Background automating new features within mapping or perception pipelines

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, robotics, or a related field is preferred; specific educational requirements were not provided.
  • 5+ years of professional C++ experience
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in complex, distributed environments

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Location: California
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Start: ASAP

job.title: Technical Program Manager - Vehicle System Integration
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Vehicle System Integration

Overview

Lead the cross-functional execution behind a vehicle’s functional architecture as a Technical Program Manager supporting a Systems Engineering team. This role serves as the operational engine and technical coordinator responsible for translating high-level product definitions into safe, traceable, and technically sound system-level implementations.

You will partner with Systems Architects, Safety Specialists, Validation, Industrial Design, Product, Electrical and Software teams, Manufacturing, and other engineering stakeholders to drive requirements through validation. From managing System Technical Specification (STS) maturity and System Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (SFMEA) workflows to coordinating engineering changes and test asset configurations, you will help ensure complex vehicle systems remain aligned with program milestones and engineering objectives.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or Systems Engineer in an aerospace, autonomous vehicle, or advanced automotive environment.
  • Proven success driving complex, cross-functional programs from requirements definition through validation.
  • Practical knowledge of the systems engineering V-model lifecycle, fail-operational architectures, and requirements management frameworks.
  • Experience managing safety workflows, including:
  • System Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (SFMEA)
  • Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA)
  • Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
  • ISO 26262 and/or MIL-STD-882 compliance processes
  • Strong background in vehicle electrical/electronic system design, electrical integration, or complex hardware/software interfaces.
  • Experience with project, change, and configuration management tools such as JIRA or Smartsheet.
  • Experience with requirements management tools and processes such as Jama, Polarion, or DOORS.
  • Ability to facilitate technical and non-technical discussions with highly specialized teams, including hardware, software, safety, and manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Strong risk identification, issue resolution, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to thrive in rapid design cycles and remain flexible and highly organized amid uncertainty.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing automotive systems in body or motion domains, such as:
  • Braking
  • Steering
  • Suspension
  • Body controllers
  • Experience coordinating system-level Engineering Change Requests (ECRs).
  • Experience developing dependency matrices across product development, styling and packaging, safety, vehicle systems, vehicle integration, and validation teams.
  • Experience defining or tracking test asset configurations and mapping requirements to validation environments.
  • Experience creating program health metrics related to requirement stability, SFMEA action-item closure, verification progress, and engineering maturity.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in technical program management or systems engineering within aerospace, autonomous vehicles, or advanced automotive development.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: W2 only.
  • Duration: 6 months.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple technical and business functions and maintain execution against demanding vehicle program milestones.

job.title: Senior Instructional Designer - Manufacturing Training
job.description:
Senior Instructional Designer – Manufacturing Training

Overview

Help build the training foundation for a growing manufacturing operation. As a Senior Instructional Designer – Manufacturing Training, you will design and implement a comprehensive learning ecosystem that promotes safety, quality, compliance, and workforce readiness across manufacturing teams.

This role is ideal for an experienced instructional designer who excels at translating complex technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions into clear, engaging, competency-based learning experiences. You will develop virtual, instructor-led, and on-the-job training that guides associates from foundational knowledge through hands-on qualification. Success in this role requires comfort working in an industrial environment, collaborating closely with subject matter experts, and using digital learning tools and systems to support a high-quality training program.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop structured curricula for manufacturing and logistics associates, including:
  • Virtual training
  • Instructor-led training (ILT)
  • On-the-job training (OJT)
  • Certification and qualification frameworks
  • Create engaging virtual learning modules using Articulate 360 and Rise.
  • Apply instructional design best practices, including information chunking, interactive engagement, and accessibility standards.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and technical writers to translate technical specifications, work instructions, and SOPs into practical training materials.
  • Support technical writing teams with training-related development, style guidelines, content standards, and quality expectations.
  • Develop criteria-based assessments and practical qualification checklists to verify competency and knowledge retention.
  • Define and standardize OJT processes, qualification criteria, and transitions from virtual learning to supervised practical application.
  • Support the management and optimization of the Docebo Learning Management System.
  • Independently organize and manage training development and delivery for an assigned area.
  • Maintain high standards for content quality, organization, accessibility, and LMS delivery.
  • Collaborate with SMEs, managers, technical writers, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, in-person manufacturing environment.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of instructional design experience, specifically in a technical, industrial, or manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and developing both virtual and live training programs.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning theory and interactive engagement strategies.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Articulate 360, including Rise and Storyline.
  • Familiarity with enterprise Learning Management Systems; experience with Docebo is required.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and AI tools.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex technical documentation into clear, engaging, and action-oriented learning content.
  • Experience creating assessments, qualification checklists, certification programs, and competency-based learning experiences.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with SMEs, managers, technical writers, and manufacturing teams.
  • Ability to independently manage, organize, and deliver high-quality training content through an LMS.
  • Comfort working with technical machinery, digital applications, operational tools, and systems used in a modern manufacturing facility.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing training for autonomous vehicles, automotive production, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Background in a highly regulated industry, such as utilities, aviation, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals.
  • Experience building or scaling a manufacturing training program.
  • Experience establishing standardized OJT processes and practical qualification frameworks.
  • Experience guiding technical writers or contributing to organizational content and style standards.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and logistics operations, safety training, or compliance-focused learning programs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Professional certificate or master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Five to seven years of instructional design experience in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Direct experience developing training programs for manufacturing, logistics, automotive, autonomous vehicle, or other highly technical operations is strongly preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Hayward, California.
  • Engagement: Six-month position.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Ability to work effectively in an in-person factory environment and collaborate directly with manufacturing stakeholders.
  • Start date is ASAP.

job.title: Design Engineer
job.description:
Design Engineer – Parking Technology Solutions

Overview

Design the next generation of connected parking and mobility experiences. As a Design Engineer – Parking Technology Solutions, you’ll transform client requirements, site conditions, product capabilities, and applicable codes into accurate, buildable solutions that integrate parking access and revenue control, guidance, payment, security, and analytics technologies.

This client- and contractor-facing role serves as the technical bridge between concept and installation. You’ll create site-specific drawings, 3D models, network diagrams, material breakdowns, and installation-ready documentation while collaborating with Sales, Quoting, Operations, clients, and contractors throughout the project lifecycle. Your work will help deliver practical, code-conscious designs with clear scopes and minimal rework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop site-specific designs for parking access and revenue control, parking guidance, payment, security, and related technology systems.
  • Produce accurate 2D layouts and 3D models showing equipment placement, lane configurations, sightlines, clearances, cable and conduit routing, and sensor coverage.
  • Perform turn-radius analysis, clearance checks, and other technical studies as required.
  • Review designs against physical and structural conditions, municipal requirements, accessibility standards, fire and life-safety considerations, and local ordinances.
  • Create basic site network diagrams for field devices such as license plate recognition cameras, security cameras, gates, barriers, and payment kiosks.
  • Apply consistent IP addressing and naming conventions while identifying potential address conflicts across typical site networks of approximately 4–15 devices.
  • Partner with Sales to shape solutions around client objectives, site requirements, and product capabilities.
  • Support quoting and estimating with itemized equipment, material, and installation-scope breakdowns.
  • Lead technical discussions with clients and their representatives, present proposed drawings, answer questions, and manage revisions through acceptance.
  • Present accepted designs to installation contractors and confirm scope, methodology, and sequencing before work begins.
  • Support Operations and contractors with design-related questions during project delivery.
  • Maintain complete, organized design records from initial discovery and site data through final client-accepted drawings.
  • Develop and maintain standardized drawing templates, material requirements, and bills of materials.
  • Contribute to related deliverables such as safety management plans, traffic and turn-radius studies, signage, and wayfinding drawings.
  • Capture lessons learned and recurring site issues to improve design standards and reduce rework.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 3–5 years of experience producing technical or engineering drawings for physical installations, such as parking, security and access control, low-voltage systems, civil/site works, or a related technical design field.
  • Ability to work independently on client-facing design decisions.
  • Proficiency with a major CAD platform; AutoCAD experience is required.
  • Ability to create and navigate 3D models using SketchUp, Revit, or a similar tool.
  • Working knowledge of civil engineering standards and site-drawing conventions, including:
  • Clearances
  • Accessibility
  • Grading
  • Striping
  • Signage
  • Experience using Bluebeam Revu or an equivalent tool for markups, redlines, and drawing reviews.
  • Working knowledge of local network fundamentals, including:
  • IP addressing and subnetting
  • Static IP assignment
  • Basic switch and Power over Ethernet topology
  • Avoiding address conflicts
  • Diagramming self-contained site networks
  • Strong understanding of file organization, naming conventions, revision control, and project archiving.
  • Ability to interpret and reconcile client requirements, sales commitments, municipal codes, and product capabilities into a coherent, buildable design.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent designs across discovery, development, review, acceptance, and delivery.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365.
  • Willingness to collaborate across time zones with distributed Sales, Operations, and design teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with parking access and revenue control systems, parking guidance, license plate recognition, gate and barrier hardware, or LiDAR-based sensing systems.
  • Experience designing for multiple jurisdictions with varying local codes and requirements.
  • Familiarity with ADA and other accessibility standards.
  • Experience with traffic or turn-radius analysis tools such as AutoTURN.
  • Background in structured low-voltage, access control, CCTV, or related security-system design.
  • Working knowledge of Civil 3D, Revit, or MicroStation.
  • Experience with Salesforce or quoting and customer relationship management tools.
  • Autodesk Certified Professional/User certification or a comparable vendor credential.
  • Genuine interest in parking, mobility, physical security, or related technology solutions.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in drafting/CAD, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, construction-related engineering, or a similar discipline.
  • Equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Three to five or more years of relevant technical design experience, with demonstrated involvement in projects from discovery or site input through accepted, issued design.
  • Experience working directly with clients and contractors on technical drawings is strongly preferred over purely back-office drafting experience.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: United States-based position. The specific onsite, hybrid, or remote arrangement will depend on the assigned posting location.
  • Travel: Periodic domestic travel is required for client discovery meetings, design reviews, site coordination, and contractor pre-installation meetings. Travel frequency will vary based on project needs.
  • Must be comfortable presenting designs to clients and contractors and coordinating with contractors onsite.
  • A portfolio of 2D drawings and 3D models is required, demonstrating accurate dimensioning, clash-checked layouts, and designs used for actual construction or installation.
  • Portfolio materials should demonstrate end-to-end involvement in at least one project, from discovery or site input through accepted and issued design.

job.title: Jr Rev Ops Analyst
job.description:
Jr. Revenue Operations Analyst

Overview

Support a high-impact CRM data quality initiative as a Jr. Revenue Operations Analyst. In this fully remote contract role, you’ll review historical HubSpot deal records, interpret customer contracts and order forms, and ensure critical line-item information is accurately reflected in the CRM. Your work will help strengthen data integrity, support audit readiness, and improve the reliability of revenue reporting.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented, proactive professional looking to build experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Operations, business operations, or analytics within a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review historical HubSpot deal records to identify missing or incomplete line-item information.
  • Examine customer contracts, order forms, and commercial agreements to identify products, services, amounts, and other relevant details.
  • Enter and update historical deal line items in HubSpot according to established guidelines.
  • Reconcile contract information against existing CRM data to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Identify discrepancies, ambiguous contract terms, and incomplete records requiring clarification.
  • Track project progress and document completed records, open questions, and outstanding issues.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations stakeholders to confirm data-entry standards and resolve exceptions.
  • Perform quality-control checks to validate the accuracy and integrity of updated records.
  • Provide a final summary of completed records, unresolved exceptions, and recommended follow-up work.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 1–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Business Operations, CRM Administration, or a related analytical or operations role.
  • Hands-on experience with a revenue-focused CRM, such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Experience using Slack or similar collaboration tools.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and order forms and accurately extract commercial information.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when working with repetitive, data-intensive tasks.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting or escalating discrepancies.
  • Ability to work independently, remain proactive, and manage priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience with HubSpot deals, products, and line items.
  • Background supporting a B2B SaaS organization.
  • Familiarity with subscription pricing, recurring revenue, contract terms, and SaaS commercial agreements.
  • Experience with CRM migrations, historical data backfills, data cleansing, or contract-to-CRM reconciliation projects.
  • Experience supporting audit preparation or other data quality initiatives.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, analytics, operations, or a related field preferred.
  • Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of formal education.
  • Candidates with 1–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, CRM administration, business operations, or a comparable analytical function are preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Schedule: Full-time availability preferred, approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Assignment duration: Temporary contract expected to last approximately 2–3 months.
  • Must be comfortable working independently and proactively in a remote setting.
  • Must be able to review confidential contracts and accurately handle sensitive business information.

job.title: SEC Consultant
job.description:
SEC Reporting Consultant

Overview

Support accurate, timely SEC reporting for a publicly traded company through a fully remote, long-term consulting engagement. The SEC Reporting Consultant will provide hands-on expertise throughout recurring annual Form 10-K and quarterly Form 10-Q filing cycles, partnering closely with the Controller to manage document roll-forwards, financial statement tie-outs, disclosure updates, and filing preparation.

This project-based opportunity begins in January 2027 and typically requires approximately two to three weeks of work per quarter, aligned with SEC filing deadlines. The ideal consultant is a detail-oriented public-company reporting professional who can work independently, maintain continuity across reporting periods, and deliver high-quality work within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation of annual Form 10-K and quarterly Form 10-Q filings.
  • Roll forward prior-period SEC reporting documents, including financial statements, footnotes, and disclosures.
  • Perform detailed financial statement tie-outs and tick-and-tie procedures against supporting schedules and source documentation.
  • Generate and review redlines between reporting periods to identify and validate changes.
  • Assist with annual and quarterly disclosure updates to ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Coordinate with the Controller regarding reporting comments, revisions, and outstanding deliverables.
  • Prepare and update filing documents within DFIN reporting software.
  • Help manage reporting timelines and ensure filings are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Provide continuity across recurring reporting cycles by maintaining familiarity with historical filings and reporting structures.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing SEC filings for publicly traded companies, including both Form 10-K and Form 10-Q.
  • Strong understanding of SEC reporting requirements, financial statement presentation, and disclosure practices.
  • Experience independently managing:
  • SEC document roll-forwards
  • Financial statement tie-outs
  • Tick-and-tie procedures
  • Disclosure reviews and updates
  • Filing preparation
  • Ability to review redlines and validate changes between reporting periods.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently within defined SEC reporting deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration skills when working with Controllers, accounting teams, auditors, and other stakeholders.
  • Availability for recurring annual and quarterly reporting engagements.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with DFIN reporting software.
  • Prior consulting, contract, or project-based SEC reporting experience.
  • Experience supporting additional SEC filings, earnings releases, or related public-company reporting.
  • Exposure to revenue disclosure updates.
  • CPA designation.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Manager-level experience in SEC reporting, financial reporting, or public-company accounting.
  • Extensive practical experience preparing annual and quarterly SEC filings.
  • Experience supporting public companies in any industry; industry-specific experience is not required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred.
  • CPA designation preferred but not required.
  • Big Four experience is not required; direct, hands-on SEC reporting expertise is the primary consideration.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Engagement begins in January 2027.
  • Long-term, recurring consulting assignment.
  • Approximately two to three weeks of work per quarter, aligned with SEC filing deadlines.
  • Availability for the annual Form 10-K cycle and quarterly Form 10-Q cycles.
  • Ability to manage deliverables accurately and maintain continuity across recurring reporting periods.

job.title: Web Developer
job.description:
Web Developer – Content Author / Web Designer

Overview

Join a global web team responsible for delivering timely, high-quality digital experiences across websites serving audiences in Europe, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Japan. In this junior-to-mid-level role, you will manage day-to-day content updates, assemble pages using established components and building blocks, and support routine publishing across multiple international sites.

This opportunity is ideal for a proactive, detail-oriented professional who communicates clearly, manages work independently, and is comfortable navigating existing web structures. This is a content authoring and web design role—not a full-stack software engineering position. Success will come from confidently using established templates, components, and publishing processes rather than developing applications from scratch.

Required Skills

  • Experience with web content updates, page assembly, web design, or digital publishing
  • Ability to work with existing web components, templates, and building blocks
  • Basic familiarity with reading and reusing code
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent English proficiency
  • Excellent organization, self-management, and attention to detail
  • Proactive approach to identifying and completing work independently
  • Ability to manage routine publishing activities accurately across multiple global websites
  • Willingness to learn established processes, receive feedback, and adapt to changing priorities

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting websites across multiple regions or international markets
  • Familiarity with content management systems or digital publishing platforms
  • Experience working with global or distributed web teams
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or related web technologies
  • Experience assembling pages from pre-existing components rather than developing software from scratch
  • Familiarity with component-based content management and publishing workflows

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Junior-to-mid-level experience in web content, web design, digital publishing, or a related field
  • Degree, certificate, or formal training in web design, digital media, communications, or a related area
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, globally coordinated environment
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams while managing deliverables with limited day-to-day oversight

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal
  • Ability to work approximately three days per week onsite at the Lisbon office is preferred
  • Fluent English proficiency is required; translation responsibilities are handled separately
  • Comfort coordinating work across global time zones and supporting international website publishing coverage
  • This role focuses on web content authoring, page assembly, and publishing; full-stack development and core software engineering experience are not required

job.title: HubSpot Administrator
job.description:
HubSpot Administrator

Overview

Join a Revenue Operations team as the hands-on owner of a mission-critical HubSpot environment supporting Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. In this remote contract-to-hire role, you’ll manage CRM configuration, workflow automation, integrations, user permissions, and data quality while helping go-to-market teams operate more efficiently and confidently.

You’ll troubleshoot complex system issues, translate business requirements into scalable solutions, maintain reliable data flows across interconnected platforms, and contribute to broader systems strategy. This opportunity is ideal for a practical systems professional who enjoys hands-on administration, clear documentation, cross-functional collaboration, and solving ambiguous problems in a fast-moving environment.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience, including direct ownership of CRM configuration and maintenance
  • Advanced CRM administration skills, including:
  • User permissions and access management
  • Custom objects
  • Workflow automation
  • Field configuration and taxonomy
  • Data quality management and deduplication

job.title: SAP Data Entry Analyst

job.title: FP&A / Adaptive Consultant
job.description:
FP&A / Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Overview

Drive meaningful improvements in financial planning, reporting, and automation as a hands-on FP&A and Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant. This role is designed for a finance professional who understands both FP&A fundamentals and how to configure, optimize, and enhance Adaptive Planning—not simply use it as an end user.

You will partner with FP&A and Accounting stakeholders to modernize planning workflows, improve model structure, reduce manual data preparation, and build repeatable reporting processes. The engagement will focus on foundational data preparation, mapping, automation, dashboard development, and documentation that can be transitioned to a permanent FP&A team member.

This is a fully remote, three-month contract engagement with potential for extension. Candidates who can work from a San Francisco office on Thursdays for in-person FP&A collaboration are preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess existing FP&A workflows in Workday Adaptive Planning and identify opportunities to improve model hygiene, automation, and reporting.
  • Configure Adaptive Planning input templates, data mappings, custom accounts, and related processes.
  • Build recurring fixed- and variable-cost reporting by business unit and legal entity.
  • Develop standardized Excel and Google Sheets templates for accrual calculations, software capitalization, variable costs, and annual planning data.
  • Establish repeatable data-loading, validation, and reconciliation procedures using Google Sheets and financial system data.
  • Leverage the Workday for Google Sheets extension’s write-back capabilities where appropriate.
  • Create reports showing monthly cost trends, prior-period comparisons, and information needed to support forecasting.
  • Automate headcount analysis and other priority FP&A processes.
  • Support dashboard development and improve visibility into financial performance.
  • Partner with FP&A, Accounting, and management stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical, maintainable solutions.
  • Document completed workflows and train the permanent FP&A team member to maintain and enhance them.
  • Deliver foundational data preparation, mapping, and automation within a short-term consulting engagement.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring and building solutions in Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Experience independently delivering FP&A systems improvements, planning models, or reporting automation.
  • Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, expense accruals, and fixed-versus-variable cost analysis.
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including structured templates and repeatable data-preparation processes.
  • Experience mapping, validating, and reconciling financial data across multiple systems.
  • Ability to translate finance and business requirements into practical, maintainable solutions.
  • Strong FP&A or finance background with the ability to apply Adaptive Planning in a business context.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work and deliver results during a short-term consulting engagement.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working with NetSuite financial data.
  • Experience automating compensation-related expense and headcount reporting.
  • Experience building financial dashboards and management reporting.
  • Background supporting investor requests or financial due diligence.
  • Experience with Adaptive Planning implementations, system optimizations, customizations, or significant model enhancements.
  • Experience developing processes that can be effectively transitioned to permanent finance team members.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Significant professional experience in FP&A, financial planning, accounting, or a related finance function.
  • Experience serving as an FP&A systems or Adaptive Planning consultant.
  • Educational background in finance, accounting, business, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Preference for candidates who can work from a San Francisco office on Thursdays for in-person FP&A team collaboration.
  • Three-month contract engagement with potential for extension.
  • Company-issued equipment is preferred because the role may involve personally identifiable information; a virtual desktop environment may be available if needed.
  • This is a finance-focused FP&A role requiring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, rather than a general technology or systems administration position.

job.title: Payroll Manager
job.description:

  • Experience working in Linux environments, including system navigation, configuration, and testing

Embedded Validation

job.title: Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician
job.description:
Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician

Build the Electrical Systems Behind Next-Generation Autonomous Vehicles

Overview

Join a hands-on engineering team developing autonomous systems, prototype vehicles, electrical platforms, and advanced test rigs across automotive, defense, trucking, and mining applications. As a Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician, you will fabricate, install, test, and troubleshoot 12V/24V wiring systems connecting computing platforms, sensors, drive-by-wire interfaces, data networks, and power distribution components.

This onsite, lab-based role combines precision bench fabrication with installation and validation on prototype vehicles and test benches. You will collaborate closely with design engineers to identify physical build issues, support engineering changes, maintain accurate as-built documentation, and improve the reliability of prototype fleets and test systems. High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cut, strip, crimp, splice, shield, sleeve, label, and terminate low-voltage wire harnesses in accordance with IPC/WHMA-A-620 guidelines.
  • Install and route harnesses on prototype vehicles, including proper use of grommets, clips, strain relief, grounding, and clearance from heat sources and moving components.
  • Work with automotive connectors and terminals from manufacturers such as Deutsch, TE Connectivity, Molex, and Amphenol.
  • Fabricate breakout boxes, test fixtures, instrumentation harnesses, and related lab equipment.
  • Perform continuity, isolation, pull-force, and functional testing using digital multimeters, harness testers, pull testers, and basic CAN tools.
  • Troubleshoot opens, shorts, voltage drops, bad grounds, intermittent faults, connector wear, and other low-voltage wiring issues.
  • Rework harnesses based on Engineering Change Orders and maintain accurate revision records for each vehicle or test bench.
  • Update redlined drawings, pinout tables, bills of materials, wire lists, and as-built documentation when physical builds differ from design.
  • Collaborate proactively with design engineering and communicate build issues or drawing discrepancies.
  • Track tasks and priorities using tools such as JIRA and Slack.
  • Monitor wire, terminal, connector, and lab supply inventory and communicate replenishment needs.

Required Skills

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience fabricating, installing, and troubleshooting low-voltage wire harnesses.
  • Experience in automotive, aerospace, robotics, drone, industrial, or comparable environments.
  • Proficiency with crimp tools, pull testers, digital multimeters, harness testers, and basic CAN tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, harness drawings, pinout tables, and bills of materials.
  • Strong understanding of 12V/24V electrical systems, including:
  • Wire gauge selection
  • Circuit protection and fusing
  • Grounding
  • Strain relief
  • Harness routing and clearance requirements
  • Familiarity with automotive data interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, and USB.
  • Experience performing continuity, isolation, pull-force, and functional testing.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve wiring faults, including opens, shorts, voltage drops, bad grounds, intermittent issues, and connector wear.
  • Ability to rework harnesses in accordance with Engineering Change Orders and maintain accurate revision records.
  • Strong attention to detail when documenting revisions, discrepancies, root causes, and corrective actions.
  • Proactive communication skills and the confidence to raise physical build issues and drawing discrepancies with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work inside prototype vehicles and in tight or physically demanding spaces.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 certification.
  • J-STD-001 soldering certification.
  • Experience working with harness CAD outputs such as Capital, RapidHarness, or CATIA Electrical.
  • Experience building breakout boxes, test fixtures, instrumentation harnesses, or lab test equipment.
  • Experience creating redlined drawings, pinout revisions, wire lists, and as-built documentation.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Slack, or similar task and collaboration tools.
  • Experience monitoring and maintaining inventory of wire, terminals, connectors, and related lab supplies.
  • Background supporting prototype development, engineering changes, or complex electromechanical systems.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • At least 2 years of relevant hands-on low-voltage wire harness experience.
  • No specific degree or formal educational background is required.
  • Practical experience with harness fabrication, vehicle wiring, electrical testing, and troubleshooting is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting prototype vehicles, test platforms, or engineering development environments is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work location: Fully onsite and lab-based in Sunnyvale, California.
  • Schedule: Flexible start times between 6:00 AM and 9:00 AM; typically 45–50 hours per week.
  • Overtime may be approved based on business needs.
  • Approximately 15% national travel may be required to support regional vehicle testing and field activities, with potential international travel.
  • Must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity with an initial 6-month term and potential transition to direct hire.
  • High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this position.

job.title: Billing Associate

As a Billing Associate, you will manage assigned accounts, process and reconcile claims, maintain accurate accounts receivable records, and resolve billing issues with payers, outside agencies, consumers, and internal departments. This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable working with data in Excel, communicates effectively, and can balance independent work with teamwork in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Meetings Manager
job.description:

  • Experience owning the day-to-day operations of a meetings or events program from intake through execution and follow-up.
  • Ability to quickly step into an established program and maintain operations with minimal ramp-up.

  • Venue logistics and space planning, including room setup, signage, access, attendee tracking, and food and beverage.

  • Experience coordinating event logistics, meeting space, timelines, stakeholders, and budgets.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to turn data exports into clear insights and leadership-ready recaps.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to create clear enablement materials, process documentation, playbooks, guides, and program updates.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and event timelines under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently while aligning execution with program strategy.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing, Product, Sales, and event technology teams.

  • Commitment to thorough documentation and clean operational handoffs.

job.title: Payroll Director
job.description:

Lead the future of payroll operations for a complex North American organization supporting more than 10,000 employees across multiple locations and entities. The Payroll Director will oversee end-to-end U.S. payroll, time and attendance, compliance, systems, reporting, and continuous improvement in a heavily unionized environment governed by multiple Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).

This strategic leadership role will guide a high-performing payroll function, partner with cross-functional teams, strengthen operational controls, and advance digitalization and automation initiatives. The ideal candidate is a highly technical payroll professional who combines deep multi-location payroll expertise with strong people leadership, business partnering, and change management capabilities.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive payroll management experience within a large, complex North American organization of 10,000+ employees
  • 6+ years of experience managing and developing skilled payroll teams
  • Bachelor’s degree or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Extensive experience delivering payroll services in a heavily unionized environment with multiple CBAs
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations, labor laws, internal controls, and compliance requirements
  • Proven experience implementing and managing large, multi-location U.S. payroll providers
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional payroll projects

  • Experience overseeing complex biweekly and semimonthly payroll operations
  • Exceptional verbal, written, interpersonal, analytical, and business partnering skills
  • Ability to lead payroll operations across multiple locations and remote teams
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, year-end processes, and performance reporting

Preferred Education and Experience

  • At least 6 years of experience leading payroll teams and managing managers or specialized payroll professionals
  • Experience supporting a workforce of more than 10,000 employees is strongly preferred

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct accurate, timely, and compliant U.S. payroll services across multiple entities and locations
  • Oversee payroll operations for both biweekly and semimonthly populations
  • Ensure payroll processes consistently align with applicable CBAs, labor laws, tax regulations, and internal controls
  • Serve as a functional subject matter expert for UKG HCM, Kronos/Dimensions, UTA, and related payroll systems

  • Drive system enhancements, digitalization, automation, and AI-related initiatives
  • Develop business cases and present recommendations for payroll technology and process improvements

  • Oversee year-end tax activities, including W-2s, 1042-S, T4s, and Records of Employment
  • Coach, mentor, and develop the payroll operations team
  • Provide matrixed guidance to related payroll and time and attendance functions
  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and other stakeholders to improve payroll service delivery and controls

Other Requirements

job.title: XOPs Validation Engineer
job.description:

job.title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise Storage Platform & Core OS
job.description:
About the Client & Opportunity

Our client is an industry leader in enterprise data storage platforms and next-generation data architecture. They are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the roadmap and strategy for their core enterprise storage operating system and underlying hardware platform infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise software and hardware co-design. You will oversee critical platform initiatives, including controller optimization, flash media integration, fault tolerance/high availability, and seamless live updates.

Key Responsibilities


  • Core OS & Platform Roadmap: Own the product definition and strategic vision for core storage operating system services. Balance high-availability failover mechanisms, data reduction efficiency, and non-disruptive upgrade capabilities to maintain strict enterprise reliability standards.

  • Protocol & Systems Hardware Integration: Translate enterprise requirements across key block storage protocols (NVMe-oF, NVMe/TCP, Fibre Channel, iSCSI) into operational product specs that bridge new media and hardware controller innovations.

  • Data-Driven Roadmap Prioritization: Analyze system telemetry, benchmark analytics, and field performance data to uncover bottlenecks, optimize latency and throughput, and maintain a high-impact feature backlog.

  • Cross-Functional Co-Design: Partner closely with Platform Engineers, Systems QA, and Architecture teams to define technical acceptance criteria and deliver integrated hardware/software capabilities.

  • Field & Commercial Support: Create high-impact technical collateral, architectural positioning guides, and competitive insights to empower technical sales teams and enterprise customers.

Qualifications & Experience


  • Infrastructure Product Leadership: 5+ years of Product Management experience successfully defining and launching enterprise storage or infrastructure software capabilities.

  • Deep Storage Protocol Mastery: Hands-on expertise with block storage protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF/TCP) and internal storage OS mechanics (controller architecture, high availability/failover, non-disruptive upgrades).

  • Analytical & Telemetry Focus: Proven ability to leverage benchmark telemetry and system metrics (IOPS, throughput, latency, failure domain dynamics) to make data-backed product choices.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing engineering, hardware, and field teams without direct authority.


DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We post pay scales which are based on our client pay ranges. DeWinter, Maris, and our clients have the right to modify the requirements of the role which can impact the pay ranges posted.
