Join a dynamic team supporting innovation and excellence in the biotech industry. As a Sr. Administrative Assistant for the US Commercial division, you will play a vital role in enabling the success of our commercialization efforts. This hybrid position in Redwood City, CA offers an exciting opportunity to provide high-level administrative support to senior leaders, coordinate complex meetings and travel, and facilitate seamless daily operations within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage internal and external meeting logistics, including scheduling, venue arrangements, catering, and A/V setups.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, visas, accommodations, and transportation.
  • Support the preparation and organization of presentations and PowerPoint slides.
  • Handle recruitment tasks, including interview scheduling, onboarding coordination, and new hire setup.
  • Collaborate with legal and procurement teams to ensure timely execution of consulting and service agreements.
  • Process and reconcile expense reports and credit card statements with accuracy.
  • Assist with planning and executing team events, meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.

Required Skills:

  • 10+ years supporting executive leadership in an administrative capacity.
  • Exceptional organizational, project management, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Proactive with excellent self-initiative and a positive team-oriented attitude.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and project management tools like Smartsheets.
  • Knowledge of digital communication platforms, including Teams and newsletters.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher preferred.
  • Proven experience in supporting senior-level executives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid work arrangement (onsite in Redwood City, CA with flexibility).
  • Ability to support travel outside normal hours as needed.

This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to a pioneering biotech organization dedicated to making a difference. Your administrative expertise will be instrumental in driving our commercial success and supporting our leadership team.

job.title: Incoming Quality Control Technician
job.description:
Incoming Quality Control Technician

Join Our Innovative Team as an Incoming Quality Control Technician and help us uphold the highest standards of safety, reliability, and performance in autonomous delivery systems. This dynamic role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology, ensuring the quality of critical components and materials that drive our mission forward. If you are meticulous, detail-oriented, and passionate about quality assurance, this position is your chance to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing industry.

What You’ll Do:

  • Operate incoming-material structural-test equipment, executing load-and-stress protocols on received components.
  • Conduct comprehensive part inspections, including dimensional, visual, and functional assessments utilizing precision tools.
  • Perform detailed inspections of carbon fiber parts, identifying delaminations, voids, or deviations from specifications.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and blueprints to determine inspection requirements and GD&T callouts.
  • Develop and refine inspection processes, selecting proper measurement tools and deciding inspection scope.
  • Document inspection data accurately within the quality-management system, maintaining strict traceability.
  • Identify nonconformances, apply hold tags, and collaborate with Quality Engineering and suppliers for root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing inspection plans, reducing cycle times, and standardizing best practices.

Required Skills:

  • Proven experience with hand tools for precision measurement, especially calipers and micrometers.
  • Strong visual, dimensional, and functional inspection skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and GD&T callouts.
  • Experience handling composite materials, with bonus points for familiarity with carbon fiber inspection.
  • Data integrity skills, ensuring accurate documentation within quality systems.
  • Background in regulated manufacturing environments such as aerospace, medical devices, or automotive sectors.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with composite materials and their inspection processes.
  • Experience with structural testing equipment and load/stress testing protocols.
  • Knowledge of quality management software and inspection automation tools.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • A minimum of 2 years in quality inspection, preferably in high-precision manufacturing settings.
  • Relevant certifications in quality inspection or technical training in metrology are a plus.
  • An associate degree or technical diploma in manufacturing, engineering, or related fields.

Other Requirements:

  • This is an onsite role based in South San Francisco, requiring physical presence at the manufacturing facility.
  • Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • No travel is required, and prior experience working with composite materials is advantageous.

Embark on a pivotal role that combines precision craftsmanship with innovative technology—become a key player in shaping the future of autonomous delivery solutions.

job.title: UI Designer
job.description:
UI Designer

Join a dynamic team shaping the future of digital entertainment with an innovative company renowned for pushing creative boundaries. As a UI Designer, you'll play a pivotal role in crafting engaging, user-friendly interfaces that captivate audiences across multiple platforms. This is a unique opportunity to bring your artistic vision and technical expertise together, influencing the way millions experience entertainment worldwide.

Overview:
This role is centered on developing sophisticated web interfaces primarily using JavaScript, React, and GraphQL. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including design, product management, and engineering, to create seamless, high-performance user experiences. While the initial focus is on web development, there’s potential to expand into TV, iOS, and Android platforms based on your interests and the company's evolving needs. This position suits a highly motivated, innovative professional eager to impact storytelling through design and technology in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment.

Required Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience in building and deploying software with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and GraphQL.
  • Strong understanding of server-driven UI techniques and automation testing, including unit and end-to-end tests.
  • Proven ability to create highly maintainable, accessible web and TV client code with comprehensive documentation.
  • Exceptional collaborative mindset, with a dedication to continuous learning and inclusive teamwork.
  • Thoughtful problem-solving skills, balancing practicality with innovation to avoid over-engineering.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience working in the entertainment industry, particularly in finance, mobile, or TV environments.
  • Background in UX design, consumer behavior, or related fields that enhance user experience insights.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • At least 6 years of professional experience in software development or UI design roles, with a strong portfolio demonstrating previous or current projects.

Other Requirements:

  • Remote work is supported, with preferred locations in the Bay Area or NYC.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-performance environment that values creativity, innovation, and direct communication.
  • Willingness to take ownership of projects and work collaboratively across teams to deliver impactful user experiences.

job.title: Revenue Accountant
job.description:
Revenue Accountant

Overview

Support a fast-paced Revenue Accounting team as a hands-on Revenue Accountant on a contract basis. This role will help drive accurate, timely, and audit-ready month-end and quarter-end close activities through SOX control workbooks, account reconciliations, revenue validations, collections support, and financial reporting schedules.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to resolve billing and order-to-cash challenges, support accounting projects and system implementations, and identify opportunities to improve processes. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable, Revenue Accounting, or a related accounting function
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience with revenue accounting, account reconciliations, journal entries, supporting schedules, and close-related deliverables
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare SOX control workpapers that stand independently under audit review
  • Ability to understand and articulate the purpose and intent of accounting controls
  • Experience with collections and analytical accounts receivable activities
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation, and large data sets
  • Proficiency with NetSuite and Salesforce
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of reviewing work for accuracy and completeness
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple deliverables, and meet recurring close deadlines
  • Proactive, analytical, and adaptable approach to problem-solving
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and process improvement skills

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Big Four public accounting experience
  • CPA certification
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance requirements
  • Experience with Google Workspace, including Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail, and Calendar
  • Background in SaaS, public accounting, or a public company environment
  • Knowledge of SaaS revenue recognition processes
  • Experience supporting audit preparation, complex reconciliations, quarterly financial statement disclosures, or financial reporting
  • Experience participating in User Acceptance Testing and post-launch system validations

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain accurate, audit-ready SOX control workbooks, validating input data accuracy and completeness through system reports
  • Execute monthly accounting activities in NetSuite, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and close-related deliverables
  • Prepare deal and contract summaries for significant transactions in accordance with ASC 606
  • Support revenue close validations by pulling, comparing, and reconciling data from NetSuite and Salesforce
  • Prepare book calculations and tie supporting schedules to the general ledger
  • Support collections forecasting and accounts receivable management
  • Assist with quarterly accounts receivable and revenue footnote schedules
  • Prepare supporting schedules for financial reporting and ensure all schedules are accurate and audit-ready
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing and post-launch validations for new products and services
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to streamline the order-to-cash cycle and resolve complex billing bottlenecks
  • Communicate status proactively, flag issues early, and clearly document conclusions and follow-up items
  • Contribute to ad hoc accounting projects and process improvement initiatives

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in revenue accounting, accounts receivable, or a related accounting function
  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes, revenue recognition activities, financial reporting, or order-to-cash operations
  • CPA certification and Big Four experience are strongly preferred

Other Requirements

  • Contract position from 11/09/2026 through 03/17/2027
  • Hybrid work arrangement based in Palo Alto, California
  • Onsite presence is required Monday through Wednesday each week
  • Remote work is permitted on Thursday and Friday
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Commitment to maintaining accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready work throughout the engagement

job.title: Program Manager IV
job.description:
Program Manager IV – Strategic Finance Programs

Overview

Lead high-impact initiatives that advance financial systems, operational excellence, and business transformation within a global organization. As a Program Manager IV, you will oversee complex, cross-functional programs spanning Finance, Operations, Legal, People Operations, Technology, and other partner teams.

This senior-level opportunity is ideal for a strategic program leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, navigate complex interdependencies, and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders. You will drive end-to-end program delivery, establish governance, manage risk, coordinate multiple workstreams, and guide organizational change across global teams and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end program management for high-visibility, high-impact initiatives, including planning, governance, risk management, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with Finance leadership and cross-functional teams to define requirements, align milestones, and drive delivery across multiple workstreams.
  • Synthesize complex, cross-functional updates into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Assess interdependencies across people, processes, technology, and regulatory requirements while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
  • Establish governance cadences that promote stakeholder alignment, timely issue escalation, and efficient decision-making.
  • Maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, decision logs, milestone tracking, and other program management artifacts.
  • Coordinate teams with competing priorities across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Drive change management and organizational readiness for new operational processes and reporting structures.

Required Skills

  • 8–9 years of experience in strategic program or project management within Finance, Operations, Corporate Development, or a related function.
  • Proven success leading large-scale, cross-border programs across multiple time zones.
  • Strong understanding of finance operating models, including:
  • Statutory reporting
  • Transfer pricing
  • Payroll
  • Tax compliance
  • Accounting processes
  • ERP and financial systems enablement
  • Experience leading programs with significant cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to quickly build rapport with senior leaders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable narratives.
  • Strong program governance discipline, including roadmaps, RAID tracking, decision logs, milestone management, and executive reporting.
  • Ability to independently navigate ambiguity, demonstrate ownership, and drive progress with a strong bias for action.
  • Proficiency with project collaboration and productivity tools, including Jira, Confluence, Slack, and Google Workspace.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working for multinational or Fortune 500 organizations.
  • Background in finance transformation, Finance PMO, M&A integration, Corporate Development, or product management.
  • Experience working with top-tier consulting firms.
  • Experience in the SaaS or Fintech industry.
  • Experience managing international finance, statutory compliance, or regulatory compliance programs.
  • Familiarity with M&A integration or corporate development processes.
  • Experience driving organizational change and readiness for new operational processes or reporting structures.
  • Experience using collaborative work management tools to support strategic program delivery.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is a plus.
  • Extensive experience leading Finance PMO, transformation, or complex enterprise programs.
  • Experience working with global teams and managing initiatives across multiple geographies and time zones.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote within the United States.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week.
  • Travel: No travel is expected.
  • Contract duration: Through 06/30/2027, with the possibility of extension based on business needs and individual performance.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams and senior stakeholders across multiple time zones.
  • Equipment will be provided for the role.

job.title: SW Engineer, Service Protection
job.description:
SW Engineer, Service Protection

Overview

Join a Platform Engineering team focused on protecting applications and services from suspicious activity. As a SW Engineer, Service Protection, you’ll build, refactor, and scale primarily backend systems that help identify and block spam, bots, fraud, and denial-of-service (DoS) threats.

Spam prevention will be the primary focus, with opportunities to contribute to additional service-protection initiatives. You’ll help strengthen resilient, high-availability infrastructure while working with C#, Azure technologies, and modern telemetry tools. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, improving existing systems, and building security-focused platforms at scale.

Required Skills

  • Strong professional experience in software engineering, particularly backend or cloud-based development
  • Professional experience with C# is ideal; equivalent experience with Python, Java, or Go may also be considered
  • Experience refactoring, scaling, and improving existing software systems
  • Understanding of security, threat detection, suspicious-activity identification, or related service-protection concepts
  • Knowledge of spam prevention, network security, or high-availability system design
  • Ability to analyze complex data and develop effective technical solutions
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with bot mitigation, fraud detection, spam prevention, or DoS protection
  • Familiarity with machine learning or AI applications in security
  • Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms
  • Knowledge of Kusto or Azure Data Explorer
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
  • Familiarity with web protocols and application-layer security
  • Experience supporting frontend issues or contributing to smaller frontend projects
  • Background building scalable, resilient, and high-availability systems
  • Familiarity with development assistance tools such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, or Claude Code

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Several years of professional experience in software development, backend engineering, cloud engineering, or security-focused development
  • Demonstrated success improving, scaling, or deploying systems that support security, reliability, or high availability

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid role based in Seattle, WA
  • The team typically works from the Seattle office on Tuesdays and Thursdays; contractor attendance is flexible, with onsite collaboration preferred a few times per month
  • The role is primarily backend-focused, with occasional opportunities to address frontend issues or contribute to smaller frontend projects
  • No specific travel or certification requirements are indicated
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving security threats, detection techniques, and engineering practices

job.title: Audio Visual Technician
job.description:
Join a dynamic team as an Audio Visual Technician and play a crucial role in delivering seamless conference technology and digital signage support for cutting-edge internal company events. Located onsite in Foster City, CA, this role offers an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of innovative AV solutions, supporting live streams, executive meetings, and large-scale corporate gatherings. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for troubleshooting and technical excellence, this is your chance to shine in a pivotal support role transforming how teams connect and communicate.

Required Skills:

  • 1-3 years of experience in AV or IT support roles
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Proven ability to support and troubleshoot conference room equipment, including displays, cameras, speakers, and controllers
  • Experience managing live production for company events, including streaming to multiple locations
  • Familiarity with Zoom Rooms, conferencing hardware, and digital signage
  • Basic knowledge of networking, Windows, and macOS troubleshooting
  • Ability to prioritize and manage an AV support ticket queue effectively
  • Customer-focused approach with excellent follow-up skills

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience providing white-glove support for executives
  • Knowledge of configuring iOS, macOS, and other meeting room hardware
  • Troubleshooting connectivity issues and real-time problem solving during live events

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Relevant certifications or training in AV technology or networking
  • Proven track record in supporting enterprise-level conference and live streaming events

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite role only; ability to support physical equipment in conference environments
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic setting with occasional need for urgent support during live events
  • No travel required

Step into this vital role and help ensure every meeting, presentation, and live streamed event runs flawlessly, supporting the company's internal communications and collaborative success.

job.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
job.description:
Senior Systems Administrator

Overview

Join a mission-driven organization advancing bold and equitable climate action as a Senior Systems Administrator. In this high-impact role, you will help architect, secure, automate, and scale the infrastructure supporting a distributed workforce and global operations.

You’ll serve as a senior technical resource across Azure and hybrid-cloud environments, enterprise networks, databases, endpoints, and corporate systems. This position combines strategic infrastructure planning with hands-on administration, Tier 3 troubleshooting, automation, vendor coordination, documentation, and technical leadership. Your work will strengthen system resilience, security, performance, and operational efficiency across the organization.

This is a full-time, six-month contract position with potential for extension.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, deploy, and optimize Azure and hybrid-cloud infrastructure for high availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Manage servers, virtualization platforms, network equipment, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, internet services, and related infrastructure.
  • Administer SQL database environments, including performance, security, backups, recovery, and high-availability capabilities.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, Infrastructure as Code, and orchestration tools.
  • Manage enterprise web environments, including IIS, Linux/PHP, WordPress, or comparable platforms.
  • Support Mac and Windows workstations, laptops, endpoints, and corporate systems.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for complex infrastructure, systems, networking, endpoint, and corporate technology issues.
  • Manage Jira workflows, ticket escalations, documentation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Implement patching, system hardening, monitoring, backup, encryption, SSL certificate, and disaster recovery processes.
  • Support IT security audit requirements and compliance-focused infrastructure practices.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external support partners.
  • Lead system planning, testing, deployments, firmware updates, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
  • Mentor junior IT staff and provide technical training and knowledge transfer.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, equipment inventories, runbooks, and operational procedures.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years of progressive experience in systems administration, infrastructure design, and cloud architecture.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise Windows infrastructure.
  • Proficiency supporting Mac systems, Windows systems, endpoints, and corporate technology.
  • Experience with Jira, help desk operations, ticket escalation, and Tier 3 technical support.
  • Strong knowledge of network administration, including VPN, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and network equipment.
  • Experience with SQL Server administration, database maintenance, backups, recovery, and high availability.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and/or Python scripting for automation and administration.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code or configuration-management tools.
  • Knowledge of IIS, Linux/PHP, WordPress, or comparable enterprise web environments.
  • Experience with system hardening, patch management, security controls, backups, encryption, SSL certificates, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • A proactive, service-oriented, collaborative, and helpful approach to problem-solving.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise backup and encryption systems.
  • Experience supporting IT audits and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery testing, failover planning, and high-availability design.
  • Experience managing vendors, contractors, or third-party support providers.
  • Experience mentoring junior IT professionals or leading technical initiatives.
  • Familiarity with remote or distributed workforce environments.
  • Experience supporting a sustainability-focused, nonprofit, or mission-driven organization.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Relevant education in information technology, computer science, systems administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Candidates should bring 6–8+ years of progressive experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, and cloud architecture.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of formal education.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with a preference for candidates who can work onsite approximately two days per week in the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Candidates near office hubs in Portland, Oregon; Portland, Maine; or New York, New York may also be considered.
  • Remote candidates may be considered within eligible U.S. states, including California, Oregon, New York, Washington, Maine, Texas, Colorado, Michigan, Florida, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Virginia, the District of Columbia, Georgia, Utah, and Illinois.
  • Pre-existing authorization to work in the United States is required.
  • Sponsorship and work authorization assistance are not available.
  • Relocation assistance is not provided.
  • Must be able to contribute effectively in a collaborative, service-focused IT environment and participate in onsite work as required.

job.title: PCB Engineer
job.description:
PCB Engineer — High-Speed Computing Hardware

Overview

Design the next generation of high-performance electronic systems as a PCB Engineer supporting advanced GPU, CPU, server, and other computing platforms. You will own critical PCB design and layout activities—from ASIC ball-out definition and component placement through routing, verification, and manufacturing release. Working closely with Board Design, Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, Mechanical, Thermal, Packaging, and Manufacturing teams, you will help deliver reliable, manufacturable, high-speed hardware.

Required Skills

  • Recent experience designing and laying out complex, high-speed electronic systems
  • Proficiency with Altium Designer or an equivalent PCB CAD platform
  • Strong expertise in:
  • High-speed routing
  • HDI technologies
  • Dense BGA designs
  • PCB stack-up development
  • Impedance control
  • Power delivery networks
  • Experience developing design rules and constraints for high-speed interfaces, including PCIe, memory, and SERDES
  • Ability to define ASIC ball-outs, component footprints, component placement, routing strategies, stack-ups, and design constraints
  • Understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly, and manufacturing processes
  • Experience performing PCB verification and design rule checks
  • Ability to generate and review manufacturing outputs, including ODB++, Gerber files, and fabrication documentation
  • Strong collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience designing CPU, GPU, data center, or other high-performance computing platforms
  • Familiarity with ASIC-driven PCB development workflows
  • Experience supporting PCB design automation initiatives
  • Experience partnering closely with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity teams
  • Background working with advanced high-speed interfaces and demanding power delivery requirements

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Degree or equivalent technical background in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, or a related discipline
  • Multiple years of hands-on PCB design and layout experience involving complex, high-speed electronic systems
  • Experience supporting complete PCB development cycles, from architecture, placement, and routing through verification, documentation, and manufacturing release

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement may be onsite in the Mountain View or Boston area; remote work may also be possible, with the final arrangement to be confirmed
  • Three-month contract with potential contract-to-hire opportunity
  • Availability to start as soon as possible
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed and multidisciplinary engineering teams

job.title: Senior Analyst, Renewals Operations & Analytics
job.description:
Senior Analyst, Renewals Operations & Analytics

Overview

Join a remote Revenue Operations team focused on strengthening renewal visibility, forecast accuracy, and data integrity. As the Senior Analyst, Renewals Operations & Analytics, you will take a hands-on role in building, validating, and maintaining the FY27 Available to Renew (ATR) model while supporting a consistent weekly renewal forecasting cadence.

Working closely with Renewals leadership, Global Renewals Owners, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance, you will help ensure forecast outputs reflect current business conditions. Your analysis will enable leaders to understand where the renewal business stands, why forecasts are changing, and where action is needed.

This role is well suited to an analytical problem solver who can work directly in Salesforce, Snowflake, notebook-based scripting environments, and spreadsheets—and translate complex account-level activity into concise, leadership-ready insights.

Required Skills

  • Five or more years of experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related go-to-market analytics role.
  • Experience owning or building a recurring forecasting process.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce and Snowflake, including renewal opportunities, quoting, linking, and diagnosing data issues.
  • Working proficiency with Google Colab or a comparable notebook-based scripting environment; Python experience is preferred.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting analytics workflows, including tools such as Alteryx.
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills.
  • Ability to build, test, validate, maintain, and document forecasting models and related workflows.
  • Experience identifying and resolving linking gaps, debooks, amendment errors, and other data-integrity issues.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain forecast movement and account-level changes through concise, leadership-ready narratives.
  • Comfort working within a weekly forecasting cadence, including when data requires investigation or remediation.
  • Ability to work independently with limited ramp time, manage competing priorities, and document processes thoroughly.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills when partnering with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Direct experience building or maintaining an Available to Renew (ATR) or comparable renewal-tracking model.
  • Experience supporting renewal-risk analysis or a Renewal Save program.
  • Background in a SaaS or education technology renewals environment.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience improving forecast accuracy, reducing unlinked data, or strengthening renewal reporting.
  • Experience preparing account-level analysis and written deal summaries for leadership review.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in renewals, revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or maintaining forecasting models and recurring reporting processes.
  • Professional experience using Salesforce, Snowflake, Python or notebook-based scripting, Alteryx, Excel, and Google Sheets in a business analytics environment.
  • Experience partnering with business leaders and technical teams to improve data quality, reporting workflows, and operational processes.
  • A specific degree or formal certification is not required; relevant hands-on experience is valued.

Other Requirements

  • Remote position.
  • Immediate availability preferred to support an ASAP start.
  • Open-ended contract engagement, with the potential for extension, conclusion, or conversion to a full-time position based on business needs.
  • Ability to support a consistent weekly forecasting cadence.

  • No travel requirement is specified for this role.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Post-Sale
job.description:
Technical Product Manager, Post-Sale

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer

Overview

Join a hands-on hardware engineering team in Mountain View, CA, as an Electrical Design Engineer responsible for developing high-performance electrical systems across power, control, mixed-signal, and high-speed interconnect applications. You will help take complex hardware from concept through production while contributing to board bring-up, signal and power integrity, system troubleshooting, validation, and cross-functional hardware integration.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving challenging hardware problems in the lab and is motivated to advance product performance, reliability, and manufacturability.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong proficiency in schematic capture and electrical design using Altium or equivalent EDA software
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Board bring-up and hardware debugging
  • Lab experiments and physical board verification
  • Signal testing and system troubleshooting
  • Board-level and system-level validation
  • Experience designing and developing power, control, mixed-signal, or high-speed interconnect circuits
  • Ability to develop and execute detailed test plans
  • Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management workflows and tools, such as Arena
  • Strong technical documentation skills, including design notes, test reports, and specifications
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams, component vendors, and contract manufacturers

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience designing electrical systems for networking, photonics, or other high-performance hardware applications
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces such as:
  • PCIe
  • DDR
  • Ethernet
  • SerDes
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Signal Integrity (SI)
  • Power Integrity (PI)
  • Design for Excellence (DfX)
  • Experience using Python or other scripting languages for lab test automation and tool integration
  • Familiarity with electronic manufacturing, assembly, and test methodologies
  • Experience evaluating new components, emerging technologies, and engineering processes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 3–5+ years of relevant electrical design experience, depending on education level
  • Experience taking hardware from design and prototyping through bring-up, testing, validation, and production
  • Background working with complex, high-performance electronic systems

Other Requirements

  • This is an onsite position in Mountain View, CA.
  • The position is offered as a 4-month contract-to-hire opportunity.
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible is preferred.
  • The role requires hands-on laboratory work, hardware testing, and collaboration with engineering and manufacturing partners.

job.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
Join Our Team as a Senior AI/ML Engineer

Are you passionate about pioneering advanced AI and machine learning solutions that drive innovation? We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of cutting-edge agent orchestration systems and transformative workflows. This role plays a vital part in building scalable, reliable AI platforms that empower enterprise-level applications in a fully remote setting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize multi-agent orchestration workflows, including prompt templating, intent routing, and conversation memory, using Python, asyncio, and FastAPI.
  • Integrate and standardize Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools across various enterprise products.
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines to benchmark LLM accuracy, routing, and latency, ensuring high standards in performance and compliance.
  • Implement dynamic gating and entitlement routing to support secure, multi-tenant environments.
  • Develop telemetry, monitoring, and logging solutions for system observability using Datadog, Snowflake, and OpenTelemetry.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with Python, including high-throughput, asynchronous service development.
  • 2+ years building production-class LLM applications, with expertise in agent workflows, function calling, and multi-agent protocols such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
  • Deep understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), RESTful API design, and orchestration architectures.
  • Proven experience designing automated evaluation and benchmarking strategies for LLMs.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/Kafka), vector databases, and data warehouses like Snowflake.
  • Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing, automation, and team collaboration.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior experience in enterprise SaaS or tax/compliance technology domains.
  • Knowledge of streaming architectures, semantic caching, and latency optimization.
  • Understanding of IAM/RBAC models and enterprise security standards such as SOC 2, ISO.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven track record in leading complex AI/ML projects and working within fast-paced tech environments.

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is fully remote with no travel requirements.
  • Availability to start around November 30th for a 1-year engagement.
  • W2 employment status only; no monetary details provided here.

Elevate your career by contributing to innovative AI platforms that shape the future of enterprise intelligence.

job.title: Executive Recruiter
job.description:
Executive Recruiter

Elevate your career by leading transformative executive searches across key organizational functions in a dynamic, remote setting. As an integral partner to C-level and senior leaders, you'll drive strategic talent acquisition efforts that shape the future of a forward-thinking organization. This role offers the opportunity to influence high-impact hiring decisions, craft exceptional candidate experiences, and utilize cutting-edge AI tools to streamline complex recruiting processes—all while maintaining the utmost professionalism and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead full-cycle searches for senior leadership roles across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, and Customer Operations.
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders to define role requirements, success metrics, and hiring strategies.
  • Conduct comprehensive interviews to evaluate leadership capabilities, cultural fit, and organizational readiness.
  • Develop data-driven and inclusive search strategies to ensure diverse candidate slates.
  • Prepare insightful, polished candidate summaries and provide strategic recommendations to senior management.
  • Maintain clear and confident communication throughout the process, providing market insights and progress updates.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance outreach, scheduling, and documentation, while delivering personalized candidate engagement.

Required Skills:

  • Deep understanding of leadership assessment, organizational structures, and business context.

  • Exceptional interviewing, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and AI-enhanced recruiting tools (e.g., ChatGPT, automation assistants).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into executive-ready updates.

Nice to Have Skills:

Join us in transforming leadership talent acquisition—where strategic vision meets innovative talent solutions.

job.title: UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst
job.description:
UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst

Join a pioneering team shaping the future of autonomous transportation as a UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst. This critical role focuses on leveraging your expertise in workforce management systems, particularly UKG Pro Advanced Scheduling, to optimize scheduling configurations and improve operational efficiency. As a key member of the Workforce Management team, you will help identify gaps, recommend improvements, and ensure the scheduling system accurately supports the company's dynamic needs in a hybrid environment in Foster City, CA.

What You Will Do:

  • Assess and analyze the current UKG Advanced Scheduling setup, pinpointing inefficiencies and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Collaborate with Workforce Management colleagues and schedulers to translate operational needs into system configurations.
  • Support the implementation, testing, and validation of configuration changes to ensure optimal performance.
  • Document system configurations, testing outcomes, and improvement recommendations for ongoing team use.
  • Utilize forecasting and operational data to evaluate scheduling outcomes, develop reports, and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Perform targeted analysis to support scheduling improvements and related workforce initiatives.

Required Skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience configuring or optimizing UKG Pro Workforce Management Advanced Scheduling.
  • Ability to assess existing scheduling systems, identify improvements, and validate outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of workforce forecasting, capacity planning, and translating operational requirements into system configurations.
  • 3–5 years of experience in workforce management, operations analytics, or similar fields.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with an eye for detail and data integrity.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with other workforce management tools such as NICE.
  • Background in large-scale, 24/7 service environments, fleet operations, or contact centers.
  • Detailed knowledge of workforce management platforms beyond UKG.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, Business, or related fields.
  • Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Other Requirements:

  • Hybrid work environment in Foster City, CA, requiring at least 3 days in the office.
  • Demonstrated ability to export data from UKG Advanced Scheduler to tools such as Google Sheets for analysis.
  • No coding experience necessary but an understanding of external system workflows is advantageous.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the efficiency of a forward-thinking operation, supporting cutting-edge autonomous transportation technology through expert workforce management.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Quote-to-Cash
job.description:

Lead the evolution of critical enterprise revenue systems as a Technical Product Manager, Quote-to-Cash.   • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and enterprise integrations

job.title: Estimator
job.description:
Electric Utility Project Estimator

Overview

Support the planning and delivery of complex electric utility construction projects as an Estimator in a hybrid consulting engagement based in Massachusetts. This role will develop accurate, defensible cost estimates across the full project lifecycle, including engineering, materials, permitting, environmental compliance, construction labor, equipment, and project risk.

Working closely with engineering, project management, construction teams, vendors, and other stakeholders, you’ll validate assumptions, resolve estimating challenges, evaluate capital project risks, and improve the consistency and accuracy of project estimates. Candidates may be considered at the Estimator, Senior Estimator, or Lead Estimator level based on their experience and qualifications.

Required Skills

  • Experience developing comprehensive estimates for electric utility construction or infrastructure projects
  • Knowledge of construction means and methods, project costs, and fundamental engineering principles
  • Ability to review engineering designs, drawings, site conditions, construction plans, contractual requirements, and supporting documentation
  • Experience evaluating capital project risks and recommending appropriate contingency levels
  • Ability to independently manage multiple estimating assignments, priorities, and deadlines
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, project management, construction, vendors, and other cross-functional teams
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as required

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with electric utility construction or infrastructure projects
  • Background in construction estimating, utility project management, or project risk management
  • Experience developing estimates for large, complex capital projects
  • Familiarity with Sage Estimating or comparable estimating software
  • Experience using risk registers, quantitative risk assessments, contingency development, or Monte Carlo simulations
  • Experience comparing estimated costs and schedules with actual project results to improve future estimates
  • Previous consulting or contract experience in an engineering, construction, infrastructure, or utility environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Finance, or a related field; or
  • Associate degree with at least two years of relevant experience; or
  • At least five years of relevant professional experience and training in place of a degree
  • Professional experience in estimating, project cost analysis, utility construction, or a related field

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with onsite responsibilities based in Massachusetts
  • Engagement type: Consulting/contract
  • Ability and willingness to travel to project sites when required
  • Candidates may be considered at the Estimator, Senior Estimator, or Lead Estimator level based on experience and qualifications

job.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
job.description:
Hardware Engineer - Test Development

Join a pioneering team at the forefront of vehicle technology as a Hardware Engineer specializing in Test Development. This critical role offers the opportunity to shape the future of automotive hardware systems by developing robust testing methodologies, collaborating with leading suppliers and engineers, and ensuring the highest standards of hardware performance for cutting-edge vehicles. If you're passionate about innovation, detail-oriented, and ready to make an impact, this is your chance to be part of an exciting journey.

Role Overview:

As a Hardware Engineer in Test Development, you will develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies for hardware components at both the system and module levels. Working onsite in Foster City, you'll utilize advanced testing equipment to characterize, validate, and improve hardware performance and reliability for vehicle-use applications. Your contributions will be essential in bridging design concepts with real-world functionality through meticulous testing and infrastructure development, supporting the advancement of autonomous vehicle technology.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in electronics or hardware testing
  • Strong proficiency with oscilloscopes, network analyzers, environmental chambers, and other electrical/environmental test equipment
  • Hands-on experience developing test setups from block diagrams, BoMs, and test plans
  • Skilled in developing custom test assets such as load simulators, test harnesses, and automation scripts in Python
  • Knowledge of PCB design tools (Altium preferred), 3D modeling (3DExperience or Catia preferred)
  • Familiarity with Ubuntu OS and scripting in Python
  • Ability to review and draft test plans, design reviews, and data reports

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience testing automotive, aerospace, or vehicle electronic components
  • Advanced knowledge of Ethernet switch chipsets (Broadcom, Marvell), PCIe, CAN, SPI, I2C, MDIO protocols
  • Experience with simulation tools such as Ansys and requirements management tools like Polarion
  • Understanding of systems architecture, networking, and vehicle communication protocols
  • Background with data acquisition systems (UEI, Keysight) and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence)
  • Participation in team competitions such as SAE, FIRST, or DARPA programs

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering or related disciplines
  • 2+ years of hands-on work in electronics development and testing
  • Experience working with early prototypes and qualification testing for vehicle applications

Other Requirements:

  • On-site presence required in Foster City (5 days/week)
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, suppliers, and design engineers
  • Enthusiastic, innovative self-starter prepared to tackle challenging projects

Embark on a career defining role where your expertise will support groundbreaking advancements in autonomous vehicle technology—apply now to be part of this innovative engineering team.

job.title: Ads Policy Coordinator
job.description:

Join a dynamic, global team dedicated to creating a safe and positive advertising experience for millions of members. As an Ads Policy Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and enforcing advertising standards that uphold the integrity of our platform. This is a vital position within a collaborative environment, offering the opportunity to influence high-volume policy operations and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and member satisfaction.

What You'll Do:

  • Review creatives and advertiser submissions against established ad policies, making approval, rejection, or modification decisions, and documenting rationales.
  • Serve as a first-line responder for policy questions from Ad Sales and Account Management via Slack and proprietary platforms, providing clear guidance or escalating complex issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve policy enforcement processes, streamline workflows, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Manage vendor training schedules and support ongoing policy education initiatives.
  • Collaborate with legal, engineering, product, and global teams to ensure policies are scalable, clear, and effectively implemented.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in content moderation, trust & safety, or policy operations within the internet or digital advertising sector.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex policy guidance in clear, simple language.
  • Strong organizational skills with an aptitude for managing high-volume inquiries (~10/day).
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams, respond quickly, and adapt to dynamic workflows.
  • Experience working closely with legal, sales, and operational teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience with advertising or platform compliance at a major digital or media company.
  • Familiarity with ad platforms such as NAS, Slack, or related tools.
  • Knowledge of international advertising standards and global regulatory considerations.
  • Background with vendor management or training initiatives.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Business, Law, or related field.
  • 2+ years of relevant policy, content moderation, or compliance experience, ideally in fast-paced digital environments.
  • Experience working in a remote or distributed team.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be available to start promptly.
  • This role is fully remote; candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.
  • Ability to handle high-volume, routine queries efficiently and with professionalism.

Become a part of a forward-thinking team that values safety, clarity, and member trust. Your expertise will help shape a platform that delivers engaging, responsible advertising experiences worldwide.

job.title: Sr Productivity Platform Developer - Asana
job.description:
Sr Productivity Platform Developer – Asana

Overview

Lead the design, governance, and evolution of an enterprise Asana platform that enables teams to plan, track, and deliver work with greater clarity, accountability, and efficiency. As the primary technical owner and architect, you will build scalable workflows, reusable templates, automations, integrations, and governance standards that support cross-functional teams across the organization.

This high-impact role is ideal for a hands-on platform expert who combines systems design, business process optimization, technical configuration, and stakeholder partnership. You will collaborate with Engineering, Datacenter Operations, IT, Security, and Identity teams to translate complex business requirements into secure, maintainable, and easy-to-use Asana solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture, governance, and continuous improvement of the Asana and Unito platforms.
  • Establish standards for teams, portfolios, projects, custom fields, templates, naming conventions, data quality, and platform usage.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes and translate requirements into scalable Asana solutions.
  • Design and implement cross-functional workflows using projects, templates, forms, rules, approvals, custom fields, and portfolios.
  • Serve as the primary Asana administrator and subject-matter expert.
  • Manage global settings, security controls, user provisioning and deprovisioning, licensing, permissions, and sharing models.
  • Build and maintain automations and integrations with tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, email, Jira, Salesforce, GitHub, and internal applications.
  • Use APIs, webhooks, and workflow automation platforms to orchestrate cross-system processes.
  • Collaborate with Security and Identity teams to support SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, multifactor authentication, least-privilege access, and auditability.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting, and usage analytics to measure adoption, data quality, capacity, and workflow effectiveness.
  • Create documentation, runbooks, configuration guides, and internal support resources.
  • Lead training sessions, office hours, and enablement initiatives to help teams become confident, self-sufficient Asana users.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex Asana issues and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams and platform support resources.

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of experience in enterprise IT, SaaS administration, business systems, or enterprise application engineering.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience administering Asana for a mid-sized or large organization with 1,000+ users.
  • Demonstrated ownership of global Asana configuration, governance, platform standards, and data-quality practices.
  • Deep expertise with Asana capabilities, including:
  • Organization, team, and project structures
  • Portfolios, goals, workload views, and dashboards
  • Custom fields, forms, rules, approvals, and templates
  • Advanced search, reporting, and usage analytics
  • Guest access, permissions, and sharing models
  • Proven experience designing and launching complex, cross-functional Asana workflows, such as campaign management, go-to-market programs, intake and triage, and operational runbooks.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management concepts, including:
  • SSO/SAML
  • SCIM provisioning
  • Multifactor authentication
  • Role-based and least-privilege access controls
  • Integration with identity providers such as Okta or Entra ID
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and API clients.
  • Scripting or development experience with Python, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Experience using workflow automation platforms such as Workato, Zapier, or similar tools.
  • Ability to integrate Asana with enterprise applications and collaboration tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with non-technical stakeholders, conduct discovery, document requirements, and recommend pragmatic, scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, presentation, and training skills.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience implementing or maturing Asana and Unito in a high-growth, cloud-native, or engineering-focused organization.
  • Experience establishing SaaS governance and operating models, including intake, change management, release practices, and configuration standards.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools such as Tableau for reporting, capacity planning, and executive insights.
  • Experience with event-driven integrations, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and error-handling strategies.
  • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX, or GDPR.
  • Relevant certifications or demonstrated expertise in adjacent areas such as Okta, ITIL, project management, or business analysis.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Extensive experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms, including hands-on Asana administration.
  • Experience supporting multi-team environments and driving platform adoption through documentation, enablement, and continuous improvement.
  • A specific educational requirement is not provided for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Six-month contract assignment.
  • Hybrid work environment with three days onsite per week.
  • Position is based in Belleview, Sunnyvale, or Dallas; West Coast locations are preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Willingness to lead training sessions, office hours, and enablement initiatives for users with varying levels of technical experience.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with Security and Identity teams to maintain platform security, compliance, auditability, and access controls.
  • Comfort serving as an escalation point for complex Asana issues and coordinating resolution across internal teams and platform support resources.

job.title: Payroll/Staff Accountant Consultant
job.description:
Payroll/Staff Accountant Consultant

Overview

Take ownership of critical payroll operations while contributing to broader accounting and financial reporting initiatives in this contract-to-hire opportunity. The Payroll/Staff Accountant Consultant will manage payroll processing across multiple legal entities while supporting general ledger activity, month-end close, financial reporting, audit requests, and accounting projects.

This opportunity is well suited for a hands-on accounting professional who combines strong payroll expertise with sound accounting knowledge, exceptional attention to detail, and the discretion required to manage confidential employee and financial information. You will collaborate with Finance, HR, external payroll providers, and cross-functional partners while balancing recurring deadlines with a diverse range of accounting responsibilities.

Required Skills

  • Manage and process payroll for multiple legal entities accurately and on schedule.
  • Review timesheets, payroll data, deductions, garnishments, expense reimbursements, and supporting documentation.
  • Respond to employee payroll questions and resolve discrepancies professionally and promptly.
  • Maintain payroll controls and protect confidential employee and financial information.
  • Support payroll-related reporting, general ledger payroll transfers, audits, and year-end reporting.
  • Apply a strong understanding of payroll regulations, payroll taxes, deductions, garnishments, and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of general accounting principles, journal entries, general ledger activity, and month-end close processes.
  • Assist with vendor and customer master data, banking transactions, reconciliations, and other general accounting activities.
  • Support quarterly and annual financial reporting, tie-outs, supporting schedules, and accounting projects.
  • Collaborate effectively with HR, Finance, employees, external payroll providers, and other business partners.
  • Proficiency with payroll systems and accounting software.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently and across departments.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Paylocity.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Experience with BlackLine or a similar financial close and reconciliation platform.
  • Experience supporting SEC reporting, including tie-outs and supporting schedules.
  • Experience with equity-related administrative and accounting processes, including transfer agent documentation and stock issuances.
  • Experience supporting 1099 reporting and year-end requirements.
  • Experience collaborating with external payroll providers and monitoring payroll tax requirements and regulatory changes.
  • Experience supporting leaves of absence, employee work location changes, and other HR-related payroll updates.
  • Experience with payroll processing across multiple legal entities.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is required.
  • Five to eight years of professional experience in payroll, accounting, or a closely related function.
  • Experience that combines payroll administration with staff accounting, financial reporting, and month-end or year-end close support is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Employment Type: Contract-to-hire
  • Duration: Three-plus months
  • Location: Cupertino, CA
  • Work Arrangement: Fully onsite, five days per week; remote and hybrid work are not available
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Primary Focus: Payroll processing and administration with additional staff accounting responsibilities
  • Ability to manage confidential payroll, employee, and financial information with professionalism and discretion
  • Ability to balance recurring payroll deadlines with accounting projects and changing priorities

job.title: Sr. Cost Accountant
job.description:
Senior Cost Accountant

Join a leading public manufacturing company as a Senior Cost Accountant and play a vital role in optimizing financial performance through meticulous cost analysis and inventory management. This fully onsite, temp-to-hire opportunity offers the chance to contribute to a dynamic team and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced environment.

Role Overview:

job.title: Sr. Payroll Analyst
job.description:
Sr. Payroll Analyst — Global Payroll Operations

Overview

Support reliable, compliant, and scalable payroll operations across multiple countries as a Sr. Payroll Analyst. This fully remote role partners with Payroll, HR, Finance, People Technology, regional teams, and external payroll providers to troubleshoot complex issues, support payroll systems and integrations, contribute to cross-functional projects, and drive continuous process improvement.

The ideal candidate is a self-directed, analytical payroll professional who can quickly understand unfamiliar issues, investigate root causes, manage workstreams with minimal direction, and communicate practical recommendations. This opportunity is well suited for someone comfortable working across systems, vendors, regions, and time zones while helping advance global payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research payroll-related issues, identify root causes, coordinate with appropriate partners, and track items through resolution.
  • Support payroll projects and process-improvement initiatives, including requirements gathering, documentation, testing, implementation, and post-launch support.
  • Assist with Workday payroll-related configuration, business process updates, testing, troubleshooting, and coordination with People Technology partners.
  • Partner with CloudPay, ADP, and other payroll providers to investigate issues, validate outputs, track action items, and support service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation, process maps, standard operating procedures, controls, and issue logs.
  • Analyze payroll data, system outputs, and trends to identify discrepancies, risks, control gaps, and opportunities to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Support payroll integrations and data flows between Workday, payroll providers, time systems, HR systems, and Finance systems.
  • Assist with compliance, audit, and control activities by preparing reports, gathering evidence, and coordinating responses.
  • Collaborate with regional payroll partners and stakeholders to support consistent global processes while accounting for local requirements.
  • Participate in vendor governance activities, including service reviews, issue tracking, escalation follow-up, and performance reporting.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Provide global payroll coverage as business needs require.

Required Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in payroll, payroll operations, HR operations, Finance operations, or a related analytical function.
  • Experience supporting payroll processes in a global or multi-country environment.
  • Required experience with Workday Payroll or CloudPay.
  • Experience with Workday, including exposure to configuration, business processes, reporting, or testing.
  • Experience working with a managed payroll provider such as CloudPay or ADP.
  • Working knowledge of payroll systems, payroll providers, data interfaces, and payroll controls.
  • Proficiency with Google Suite.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to payroll accuracy.
  • Ability to ramp quickly, work independently with minimal direction, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow work through to completion.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and initiative to investigate issues, identify root causes, and pursue solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate across regions, functions, and time zones.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, migrations, system enhancements, or other cross-functional projects.
  • Experience with payroll or HR system configuration, integrations, testing, or release management.
  • Knowledge of OneSource Virtual (OSV) or similar payroll service and vendor environments.
  • Experience with payroll reporting, reconciliations, audit support, and internal controls.
  • Familiarity with global payroll compliance concepts and country-specific payroll requirements.
  • Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, or business intelligence platforms for data analysis and process automation.
  • Payroll certification or progress toward a relevant professional certification.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Experience supporting multi-country payroll operations and third-party payroll relationships.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment requiring sound judgment, independent ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Other Requirements

  • This is a 100% remote position.
  • The engagement is expected to last 6+ months.
  • Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of assigned workstreams.
  • Flexibility to provide global payroll support, including coverage for international regions, as business needs require.

job.title: Plant Issue Resolution Engineer - Autonomous Test Fleet & Robotaxi Pre-Production
job.description:

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer

job.title: Analytics Engineer

job.title: Senior Manager, SAP Project Accounting
job.description:
Senior Manager, SAP Project Accounting

Overview

Lead the transformation of internal project accounting within a complex SAP S/4HANA environment. As a hands-on Senior Manager, you will design and implement a consistent, scalable framework for tracking project investments, labor, external funding, capitalization, expenses, settlements, and closeout activities.

As a key member of the Corporate Controllership organization, you will establish governance for how internal projects are structured, tracked, accounted for, and closed in SAP. You will partner with FP&A, project owners, Procurement, IT, Fixed Assets, Payroll, Accounts Payable, and other Finance teams to replace manual tracking with integrated, controlled, and increasingly automated SAP-based processes.

This role is ideal for an experienced accounting and SAP professional who can translate accounting requirements into system functionality, guide implementation activities, support testing and deployment, and drive continuous improvement. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly in SAP S/4HANA and providing practical leadership rather than high-level oversight alone.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly:
  • SAP Project System (PS)
  • Controlling (CO)
  • Financial Accounting and General Ledger (FI)
  • Fixed Assets (FI-AA)
  • Experience designing, configuring, implementing, or operating SAP project accounting processes.
  • Expertise with project and WBS structures, project cost collection, accounting attributes, capitalization, settlement, reconciliation, and project close.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP related to internally developed software, cloud computing arrangements, fixed assets, capitalizable internal projects, project expenses, write-offs, and abandoned projects.
  • Experience determining when to use WBS elements, internal orders, cost centers, and other SAP controlling objects.
  • Ability to establish governance for project creation, cost classification, capitalization, settlement, and closeout.
  • Experience supporting monthly and quarterly close activities, including accruals, reconciliations, financial statement analysis, and project-related journal entries.
  • Strong understanding of the integration between project accounting and Procurement, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Payroll, expense management, cost centers, internal orders, and the General Ledger.
  • Experience partnering with SAP functional and technical teams on system design, configuration, testing, deployment, and issue resolution.
  • Experience developing test scenarios, validating accounting results, resolving defects, and supporting user acceptance testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to reduce manual journal entries, reconciliations, and offline project tracking through process improvement and automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project-management, communication, and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Accounting, FP&A, IT, Procurement, project owners, and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience leading an SAP S/4HANA implementation or large-scale finance transformation.
  • Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of SAP modules that interface with project accounting, including Materials Management (MM) or Sales and Distribution (SD).
  • Experience with internally developed software and technology project accounting.
  • Familiarity with automation technologies and opportunities to streamline accounting operations.
  • Experience developing project accounting policies, procedures, training materials, and process documentation.
  • Experience supporting SOX controls, internal audits, and external audits related to project accounting.
  • Experience developing reporting and analytics that provide visibility into project actuals, accounting status, capitalization, and financial performance.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • 10+ years of relevant accounting and finance experience.
  • Experience serving as a hands-on Senior Manager or accounting systems leader in a technology-driven, transformation-oriented environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, IT, FP&A, Procurement, Fixed Assets, and business project teams.

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid work arrangement requiring 2–3 days onsite in the South Bay area.
  • Anticipated start timeframe is late December or early January.
  • Potential for the position to transition from contract to full-time.
  • Must be comfortable working hands-on in SAP S/4HANA and guiding implementation activities rather than providing only high-level oversight.
  • Must be able to develop policies, controls, documentation, and training that support consistent adoption across the organization.
  • Must be able to partner with stakeholders to establish accurate project actuals for forecasting, financial planning, management reporting, and financial close.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Buyer

  • Hands-on experience with large ERP systems, particularly NetSuite, for procurement and inventory management.

job.title: Deploy Delivery Analyst

job.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
job.description:
